	PROCEDURE cargarestadoscolores
		local mmpp, cShape, cDesc, cHidden
		
		ThisForm.nErrores = 0
		mmpp = 0
		
		ThisForm.oTblErroresCitiCompras.IrPrimero()
		Do While !ThisForm.oTblErroresCitiCompras.EsEof()
		
			mmpp = mmpp + 1
			
			cShape	= "oShp" + allt(str(mmpp))
			cDesc	= "oDesc" + allt(str(mmpp))
			cHidden	= "oHidden" + allt(str(mmpp))
			
			if type("ThisForm." + cShape) = "U"
				ThisForm.AddObject(cShape, "tg_3dShape")
			endif
			
			ThisForm.&cShape..Left		= 12
			ThisForm.&cShape..Top		= 540 + ((mmpp - 1) * 16)
			ThisForm.&cShape..Width		= 15
			ThisForm.&cShape..Height	= 15
			ThisForm.&cShape..BackColor	= ThisForm.oTblErroresCitiCompras.Leer("Color")
			ThisForm.&cShape..BackStyle	= 1
			ThisForm.&cShape..Visible	= .t.
			
			if type("ThisForm." + cDesc) = "U"
				ThisForm.AddObject(cDesc, "tg_label")
			endif
			
			ThisForm.&cDesc..Left		= 40
			ThisForm.&cDesc..Top		= 540 + ((mmpp - 1) * 16)
			ThisForm.&cDesc..AutoSize	= .t.
			ThisForm.&cDesc..Caption	= Allt(ThisForm.oTblErroresCitiCompras.Leer("Descripcion"))
			ThisForm.&cDesc..Visible	= .t.
			
			if type("ThisForm." + cHidden) = "U"
				ThisForm.AddObject(cHidden, "tg_label")
			endif
			
			ThisForm.&cHidden..Caption = allt(ThisForm.oTblErroresCitiCompras.Leer("Validar1")) + allt(ThisForm.oTblErroresCitiCompras.Leer("Validar2"))
		
			ThisForm.oTblErroresCitiCompras.IrSiguiente()
		Enddo
		
		ThisForm.nErrores = mmpp
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE ejecutarconsulta
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE emitirdisk
		Local cDir, cRutaArchivo, cRutaArchivo1, cRutaArchivo2
		
		cDir = GETDIR()
		
		ThisForm.SetearCursorEspera()
		
		cRutaArchivo  = cDir + 'CITI_MOVIMIENTOS_' + STR(MONTH(ThisForm.oTbxFechaDesde.Value),2) + '_' + STR(YEAR(ThisForm.oTbxFechaDesde.Value),4) + '.TXT'
		cRutaArchivo1 = cDir + 'CITI_INFORME_GLOBAL_' + STR(MONTH(ThisForm.oTbxFechaDesde.Value),2) + '_' + STR(YEAR(ThisForm.oTbxFechaDesde.Value),4) + '.TXT'
		cRutaArchivo2 = cDir + 'CITI_NOTAS_CREDITO_' + STR(MONTH(ThisForm.oTbxFechaDesde.Value),2) + '_' + STR(YEAR(ThisForm.oTbxFechaDesde.Value),4) + '.TXT'
		
		
		If !ThisForm.oChkInformeGlobal.Value 
			Thisform.GenerarMovimientos(cRutaArchivo)
		Else
			Thisform.GenerarInformeGlobal(cRutaArchivo1)
			Thisform.GenerarNotaCredito(cRutaArchivo2)
		Endif
		
		
		ThisForm.DesSetearCursorEspera()
		
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE esnro_externorepetido
		Local r, cNro_Externo, cId_Sistema, lEncontrado, cId
		
		r				= ThisForm.oView.Recno()
		cNro_Externo	= ThisForm.oView.Leer("Nro_Externo")
		cId_Sistema		= ThisForm.oView.Leer("Id_Sistema")
		lEncontrado		= .f.
		cId				= ThisForm.oView.Leer("Id")
		
		
		
		ThisForm.oView.IrSiguiente()
		Do While !ThisForm.oView.EsEof() And !lEncontrado
		
			If ThisForm.oView.Leer("Id")=cId And ThisForm.oView.Leer("Nro_Externo")=cNro_Externo And ThisForm.oView.Leer("Id_Sistema")=cId_Sistema
				lEncontrado = .t.
			Endif
		
			ThisForm.oView.IrSiguiente()
		Enddo
		
		ThisForm.oView.IrRegistro(r)
		
		return lEncontrado
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE generarinformeglobal
		lParameters cRutaArchivo
		
		Local cParametroCUITPropio, cParametroNombrePropio, nHandle ,cId_Sistema, cTipo, cNumero, cFecha
		Local cCuitProveedor, cNombreProveedor, cImpuesto, cStringFinal
		
		cParametroCUITPropio	= ThisForm.oTblParametros.Leer("Cuit")
		cParametroNombrePropio	= ThisForm.oTblParametros.Leer("Nombre")
		
		nHandle = fCreate(cRutaArchivo)
		If nHandle=-1
			=fMensAceptar("Error en la apertura del archivo " + cRutaArchivo)
			return
		Else
			ThisForm.oView.IrPrimero()
			Do While !ThisForm.oView.EsEof()
		
				If ThisForm.oView.Leer("Imprime") And Empty(ThisForm.oView.Leer("Id_Sucursal")) And ThisForm.oView.Leer("ImpuestoAFIP") > 0
		
					cId_Sistema	= ThisForm.oView.Leer("Id_Sistema")
		
					cTipo					= Replicate("0", 2)
					cNumero					= Replicate("0", 24)
				    cFecha					= Space(8)
					
					If cId_Sistema="C"
			    		cCuitProveedor		= Substr(Strtran(ThisForm.oView.Leer("CUIT"), "-", Space(0)), 1, 11)
						cNombreProveedor	= Substr(ThisForm.oView.Leer("Nombre"), 1, 25)
					Else
						cCuitProveedor		= Substr(Strtran(cParametroCuitPropio, "-", Space(0)), 1, 11)
						cNombreProveedor	= Substr(cParametroNombrePropio, 1, 25)
					Endif
				    
				    cImpuesto				= Strtran(Strtran(Str(ThisForm.oView.Leer("ImpuestoAFIP"), 13, 2), Space(1), "0"), ".", Space(0))
		
				    cStringFinal			= cTipo+cNumero+cFecha+cCuitProveedor+cNombreProveedor+cImpuesto+Replicate("0", 11)+Space(25)+Replicate("0", 12)
		
			    	fPuts(nHandle, cStringFinal)
				Endif
		
				ThisForm.oView.IrSiguiente()
			Enddo
		
			fClose(nHandle)
		Endif
		
		=fMensAceptar ("Se ha grabado el archivo " + Allt(cRutaArchivo) + "") 
		
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE generarmovimientos
		lParameters cRutaArchivo
		
		Local cParametroCUITPropio, cParametroNombrePropio, nHandle ,cId_Sistema, cTipo, cNumero, cFecha
		Local cCuitProveedor, cNombreProveedor, cImpuesto, cStringFinal
		
		cParametroCUITPropio	= ThisForm.oTblParametros.Leer("Cuit")
		cParametroNombrePropio	= ThisForm.oTblParametros.Leer("Nombre")
		
		ThisForm.SetearCursorEspera()
		
		nHandle = fCreate(cRutaArchivo)
		If nHandle=-1
			=fMensAceptar("Error en la apertura del archivo " + cRutaArchivo)
			return
		Else
			ThisForm.oView.IrPrimero()
			Do While !ThisForm.oView.EsEof()
		
				If ThisForm.oView.Leer("Imprime") 
		
					cId_Sistema	= ThisForm.oView.Leer("Id_Sistema")
		
					cTipo					= Replicate("0", 2)
					cNumero					= Replicate("0", 24)
				    cFecha					= Space(8)
		
					If !Empty(ThisForm.oView.Leer("Id_Sucursal"))
						oTbl_Docu 			= iif(cId_Sistema="C", ThisForm.oTblCmp_Docu, ThisForm.oTblVnt_Docu)
						
						If oTbl_Docu.Buscar(ThisForm.oView.Leer("Id_Comproba"), .f., "Clave")
							cTipo 			= oTbl_Docu.leer("Id_CodigoAFIP")
						Endif
						
						If Allt(ThisForm.oView.Leer("Nro_Externo"))<>"-"
							cNumero			= Substr(ThisForm.oView.Leer("Nro_Externo"), 1, 4) + Replicate("0", 12) + Substr(ThisForm.oView.Leer("Nro_Externo"), 6, 8)
						Endif
		
						cFecha				= Strtran(Dtoc(ThisForm.oView.Leer("Fecha")), "/", Space(0))
					Endif
					
					If cId_Sistema="C"
			    		cCuitProveedor		= Substr(Strtran(ThisForm.oView.Leer("CUIT"), "-", Space(0)), 1, 11)
						cNombreProveedor	= Substr(ThisForm.oView.Leer("Nombre"), 1, 25)
					Else
						cCuitProveedor		= Substr(Strtran(cParametroCuitPropio, "-", Space(0)), 1, 11)
						cNombreProveedor	= Substr(cParametroNombrePropio, 1, 25)
					Endif
				    
				    cImpuesto				= Strtran(Strtran(Str(ThisForm.oView.Leer("ImpuestoAFIP"), 13, 2), Space(1), "0"), ".", Space(0))
		
				    cStringFinal			= cTipo+cNumero+cFecha+cCuitProveedor+cNombreProveedor+cImpuesto+Replicate("0", 11)+Space(25)+Replicate("0", 12)
		
			    	fPuts(nHandle, cStringFinal)
				Endif
		
				ThisForm.oView.IrSiguiente()
			Enddo
		
			fClose(nHandle)
		Endif
		
		=fMensAceptar ("Se ha grabado el archivo " + Allt(cRutaArchivo) + "") 
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE generarnotacredito
		lParameters cRutaArchivo
		
		Local cParametroCUITPropio, cParametroNombrePropio, nHandle ,cId_Sistema, cTipo, cNumero, cFecha
		Local cCuitProveedor, cNombreProveedor, cImpuesto, cStringFinal
		
		cParametroCUITPropio	= ThisForm.oTblParametros.Leer("Cuit")
		cParametroNombrePropio	= ThisForm.oTblParametros.Leer("Nombre")
		
		ThisForm.SetearCursorEspera()
			
		nHandle = fCreate(cRutaArchivo)
		If nHandle=-1
			=fMensAceptar("Error en la apertura del archivo " + cRutaArchivo)
			return
		Else
			ThisForm.oView.IrPrimero()
			Do While !ThisForm.oView.EsEof()
		
				If ThisForm.oView.Leer("Imprime") And !Empty(ThisForm.oView.Leer("Id_Sucursal")) And ThisForm.oView.Leer("ImpuestoAFIP") > 0
		
					cId_Sistema	= ThisForm.oView.Leer("Id_Sistema")
		
					oTbl_Docu 			= iif(cId_Sistema="C", ThisForm.oTblCmp_Docu, ThisForm.oTblVnt_Docu)
						
					If oTbl_Docu.Buscar(ThisForm.oView.Leer("Id_Comproba"), .f., "Clave")
						cTipo 			= oTbl_Docu.leer("Id_CodigoAFIP")
					Endif
					
					If Allt(ThisForm.oView.Leer("Nro_Externo"))<>"-"
						cNumero			= Substr(ThisForm.oView.Leer("Nro_Externo"), 1, 4) + Replicate("0", 12) + Substr(ThisForm.oView.Leer("Nro_Externo"), 6, 8)
					Endif
		
					cFecha				= Strtran(Dtoc(ThisForm.oView.Leer("Fecha")), "/", Space(0))
					
					If cId_Sistema="C"
			    		cCuitProveedor		= Substr(Strtran(ThisForm.oView.Leer("CUIT"), "-", Space(0)), 1, 11)
						cNombreProveedor	= Substr(ThisForm.oView.Leer("Nombre"), 1, 25)
					Else
						cCuitProveedor		= Substr(Strtran(cParametroCuitPropio, "-", Space(0)), 1, 11)
						cNombreProveedor	= Substr(cParametroNombrePropio, 1, 25)
					Endif
				    
				    cImpuesto				= Strtran(Strtran(Str(ThisForm.oView.Leer("ImpuestoAFIP"), 13, 2), Space(1), "0"), ".", Space(0))
		
				    cStringFinal			= cTipo+cNumero+cFecha+cCuitProveedor+cNombreProveedor+cImpuesto+Replicate("0", 11)+Space(25)+Replicate("0", 12)
		
			    	fPuts(nHandle, cStringFinal)
				Endif
		
				ThisForm.oView.IrSiguiente()
			Enddo
		
			fClose(nHandle)
		Endif
		
		=fMensAceptar ("Se ha grabado el archivo " + Allt(cRutaArchivo) + "") 
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE getcolorestado
		lParameter nError
		Local cColor, nColor
		
		if nError=0
			return rgb(255,255,255)
		else
			cColor = "ThisForm.oShp" + allt(str(nError)) + ".Backcolor"
			return &cColor
		endif
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE iniciarcomponentes
		Local mmpp
		
		ThisForm.CargarEstadosColores()
		
		ThisForm.oChkInformeGlobal.Value = .f.
		
		ThisForm.oPresentaMoneda.AsignarMonedaDefault(ThisForm.oTblParametros.Leer("Mon_Def"))
		
		ThisForm.oCmbSucursales.SetearTodos()
		ThisForm.oCmbSucursales.Value = "TD"
		
		ThisForm.oTbxFechaDesde.Value = ctod("  /  /  ")
		ThisForm.oTbxFechaHasta.Value = ctod("  /  /  ")
		
		ThisForm.oTbxProveedorDesde.valida = TG_TC_VALIDASOLOEXPRESION
		ThisForm.oTbxProveedorDesde.SetearValorInicial(Space(5))
		
		ThisForm.oTbxProveedorHasta.Valida = TG_TC_VALIDASOLOEXPRESION
		ThisForm.oTbxProveedorHasta.SetearValorInicial(Space(5))
		
		ThisForm.oTbxCatProveedorDesde.valida = TG_TC_VALIDASOLOEXPRESION
		ThisForm.oTbxCatProveedorDesde.SetearValorInicial(Space(3))
		
		ThisForm.oTbxCatProveedorHasta.Valida = TG_TC_VALIDASOLOEXPRESION
		ThisForm.oTbxCatProveedorHasta.SetearValorInicial(Space(3))
		
		ThisForm.oTbxClienteDesde.valida = TG_TC_VALIDASOLOEXPRESION
		ThisForm.oTbxClienteDesde.SetearValorInicial(Space(5))
		
		ThisForm.oTbxClienteHasta.Valida = TG_TC_VALIDASOLOEXPRESION
		ThisForm.oTbxClienteHasta.SetearValorInicial(Space(5))
		
		ThisForm.oTbxCatClienteDesde.valida = TG_TC_VALIDASOLOEXPRESION
		ThisForm.oTbxCatClienteDesde.SetearValorInicial(Space(3))
		
		ThisForm.oTbxCatClienteHasta.Valida = TG_TC_VALIDASOLOEXPRESION
		ThisForm.oTbxCatClienteHasta.SetearValorInicial(Space(3))
		
		ThisForm.OldFechaDesde		= ThisForm.oTbxFechaDesde.Value
		ThisForm.OldFechaHasta		= ThisForm.oTbxFechaHasta.Value
		ThisForm.OldId_moneda		= ThisForm.oPresentaMoneda.ConsultarMoneda()
		ThisForm.OldId_Sucursal		= ThisForm.oCmbSucursales.Value
		ThisForm.OldTipoCotizacion	= ThisForm.oPresentaMoneda.ConsultarTipoCotizacion()
		
		ThisForm.oGrdComprobantes.Column9.CurrentControl	= "TG_CHECKBOX1"
		ThisForm.oGrdComprobantes.Column9.Sparse			= .f.
		ThisForm.oGrdComprobantes.Column9.ReadOnly			= .f.
		
		for mmpp=1 to ThisForm.oGrdComprobantes.ColumnCount
			ThisForm.oGrdComprobantes.Columns(mmpp).DynamicBackColor = "ThisForm.GetColorEstado(ThisForm.oView.Leer('Error'))"
		endfor
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		dodefault()
		
		set century on
		
		ThisForm.SetearHelpConTextId("ConsultaCompras")
		
		ThisForm.AddObject("oView","Tg_ViewComprobantesComprasAFIP")
		
		ThisForm.AddObject("oTblParametros"			,"tg_tabla", "Parametros")
		ThisForm.AddObject("oTblCmp_Docu"			,"tg_tabla", "Cmp_Docu", "Clave")
		ThisForm.AddObject("oTblVnt_Docu"			,"tg_tabla", "Vnt_Docu", "Clave")
		ThisForm.AddObject("oTblErroresCitiCompras"	,"tg_tabla", "ErroresCitiCompras", "Clave")
		
		ThisForm.oGrdComprobantes.RecordSource = ThisForm.oView.Alias
		
		ThisForm.IniciarComponentes()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarcomprobante
		If ThisForm.oView.Leer("Id_Sistema")='C'
			If !Empty(ThisForm.oView.Leer("Id_Sucursal"))
				If Type("ThisForm.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCompras")<>T_OBJECT
					ThisForm.CrearYAsignarObjeto("ThisForm.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCompras","TG_ConsCompCompras",ThisForm.oView.Leer("Id_Comproba"),ThisForm.oView.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),ThisForm.oView.Leer("Id_sucursal"),ThisForm.oView.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)
				Else
					ThisForm.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCompras.ConsultarComprobante(ThisForm.oView.Leer("Id_Comproba"),ThisForm.oView.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),ThisForm.oView.Leer("Id_sucursal"),ThisForm.oView.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)
				Endif
				ThisForm.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCompras.Show()		
			Else
				=fMensAceptar("No se puede visualizar el comprobante, es un INFORME GLOBAL")
			Endif
		Else
			If !Empty(ThisForm.oView.Leer("Id_Sucursal"))
				If Type("ThisForm.oFrmConsultaComprobante")<>T_OBJECT
					ThisForm.CrearYAsignarObjeto("ThisForm.oFrmConsultaComprobante","TG_ConsultaComprobante",ThisForm.oView.Leer("Id_Comproba"),ThisForm.oView.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),ThisForm.oView.Leer("Id_sucursal"),ThisForm.oView.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)
				Else
					ThisForm.oFrmConsultaComprobante.ConsultarComprobante(ThisForm.oView.Leer("Id_Comproba"),ThisForm.oView.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),ThisForm.oView.Leer("Id_sucursal"),ThisForm.oView.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)
				Endif
				ThisForm.oFrmConsultaComprobante.Show()	
			Else
				=fMensAceptar("No se puede visualizar el comprobante, es un INFORME GLOBAL")
			Endif
		Endif
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescaraplicacion
		ThisForm.RefrescarConsulta()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarconsulta
		Local cId_sucursal, lAnulado, nImpuestoAFIPTotal, nIvaAFIPTotal, lFechaContable
		
		ThisForm.SetearCursorEspera()
		
		nImpuestoAFIPTotal	= 0
		nIvaAFIPTotal		= 0
		cId_Sucursal		= iif(ThisForm.oCmbSucursales.Value="TD", "", ThisForm.oCmbSucursales.Value)
		lAnulado			= (ThisForm.oOpgAnulado.Value=2)
		lFechaContable		= (ThisForm.oOpgFechaContable.Value=2)
		
		=aCopy(ThisForm.oSeleccionarComprobantesCompras.vItems,vComprobantesCompras)
		=aCopy(ThisForm.oSeleccionarcomprobantesVentas.vItems,vComprobantesVentas)
		
		ThisForm.oGrdComprobantes.RecordSource = ""
		ThisForm.oView.Refrescar(@vComprobantesVentas,@vComprobantesCompras,ThisForm.oTbxProveedorDesde.Value,ThisForm.oTbxClienteDesde.Value,;
													cId_Sucursal,ThisForm.oTbxFechaDesde.Value,ThisForm.oTbxFechaHasta.Value,ThisForm.oPresentaMoneda.ConsultarMoneda(),;
													lAnulado,ThisForm.oPresentaMoneda.ConsultarTipoCotizacion(),ThisForm.oTbxProveedorHasta.Value,ThisForm.oTbxClienteHasta.Value,;
													ThisForm.oTbxCatProveedorDesde.Value,ThisForm.oTbxCatClienteDesde.Value,ThisForm.oTbxCatProveedorHasta.Value,;
													ThisForm.oTbxCatClienteHasta.Value,@nImpuestoAFIPTotal, @nIvaAFIPTotal, lFechaContable, ThisForm.oChkInformeGlobal.Value)
		
		ThisForm.oGrdComprobantes.RecordSource = ThisForm.oView.Alias
		
		ThisForm.Validar()
		
		ThisForm.RefrescarGrilla()
		
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	= .f.
		ThisForm.oCmdImprimirGrilla.Enabled		= !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
		
		ThisForm.LockScreen = .f.
		
		ThisForm.DesSetearCursorEspera()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla
		ThisForm.oGrdComprobantes.RecordSource = ""
		ThisForm.oGrdComprobantes.RecordSource = ThisForm.oView.Alias
		
		ThisForm.oGrdComprobantes.Column1.ControlSource		= ThisForm.oView.Alias + ".Id_Sucursal"
		ThisForm.oGrdComprobantes.Column2.ControlSource		= ThisForm.oView.Alias + ".Id_Comproba"
		ThisForm.oGrdComprobantes.Column3.ControlSource		= ThisForm.oView.Alias + ".Nro_Referencia"
		ThisForm.oGrdComprobantes.Column4.ControlSource		= ThisForm.oView.Alias + ".Nro_Externo"
		ThisForm.oGrdComprobantes.Column5.ControlSource		= ThisForm.oView.Alias + ".Fecha"
		ThisForm.oGrdComprobantes.Column6.ControlSource		= ThisForm.oView.Alias + ".Total"
		ThisForm.oGrdComprobantes.Column7.ControlSource		= ThisForm.oView.Alias + ".Id"
		ThisForm.oGrdComprobantes.Column8.ControlSource		= ThisForm.oView.Alias + ".Nombre"
		ThisForm.oGrdComprobantes.Column9.ControlSource		= ThisForm.oView.Alias + ".Imprime"
		ThisForm.oGrdComprobantes.Column11.ControlSource	= ThisForm.oView.Alias + ".IvaAFIP"
		ThisForm.oGrdComprobantes.Column12.ControlSource	= ThisForm.oView.Alias + ".ImpuestoAFIP"
		
		ThisForm.oTbxImpuestoAFIP.Value	= Round(ThisForm.oView.Sumar("iif(Id_Sistema='C',1,-1)*iif(Suma,1,-1)*ImpuestoAFIP", ".t."),2)
		ThisForm.oTbxIvaAFIP.value      = Round(ThisForm.oView.Sumar("iif(Id_Sistema='C',1,-1)*iif(Suma,1,-1)*IvaAFIP", ".t."),2)
		ThisForm.oTbxTotal.Value		= Round(ThisForm.oView.Sumar("iif(Id_Sistema='C',1,-1)*iif(Suma,1,-1)*Total", ".t."), 2)
		
		ThisForm.oGrdComprobantes.Refresh()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE validar
		Local nError, vGrabacion[1,2], cCaption, cValid, i
		
		ThisForm.oView.IrPrimero()
		Do While !ThisForm.oView.EsEof()
		
			for i=1 to ThisForm.nErrores
				cCaption	= "ThisForm.oHidden" + allt(str(i)) + ".Caption"
				cValid		= &cCaption
			
				if &cValid
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Error", i)
					ThisForm.oView.Modificar(@vGrabacion, .f., .t.)
					exit
				endif
			endfor
			
			ThisForm.oView.IrSiguiente()
		Enddo
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oChkInformeGlobal.InteractiveChange
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled = .t.
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmbSucursales.InteractiveChange
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	= This.Value<>ThisForm.OldId_Sucursal
			ThisForm.oCmdImprimirGrilla.Enabled		= !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
		Endif	
		ThisForm.OldId_Sucursal = This.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Click
		This.Enabled = .f.
		ThisForm.RefrescarConsulta()
		ThisForm.oCmdGenerarArchivoAFIP.Enabled = .t.
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdGenerarArchivoAFIP.Click
		Local vRegistrosErrores, nRegs
		Local cClave, vDatos[1,2]
		Local lEmitir
		
		nRegs	= 0
		lEmitir	= .t.
		
		ThisForm.oView.IrPrimero()
		Do While !ThisForm.oView.EsEof()
			If ThisForm.oView.Leer("Error")<>0 And ThisForm.oView.Leer("Imprime")
				nRegs = nRegs + 1
				Dimension vRegistrosErrores[nRegs,13]
				vRegistrosErrores[nRegs,1] = ThisForm.oView.Leer("Id_Sucursal")
				vRegistrosErrores[nRegs,2] = ThisForm.oView.Leer("Id_Sistema")
				vRegistrosErrores[nRegs,3] = ThisForm.oView.Leer("Id_Comproba")
				vRegistrosErrores[nRegs,4] = ThisForm.oView.Leer("Nro_Referencia")
				vRegistrosErrores[nRegs,5] = ThisForm.oView.Leer("Nro_Externo")
				vRegistrosErrores[nRegs,6] = ThisForm.oView.Leer("Fecha")
				vRegistrosErrores[nRegs,7] = ThisForm.oView.Leer("Total")
				vRegistrosErrores[nRegs,8] = ThisForm.oView.Leer("Id")
				vRegistrosErrores[nRegs,9] = ThisForm.oView.Leer("Nombre")
				vRegistrosErrores[nRegs,10] = ThisForm.oView.Leer("Imprime")
				vRegistrosErrores[nRegs,11] = ThisForm.oView.Leer("IVAAFIP")
				vRegistrosErrores[nRegs,12] = ThisForm.oView.Leer("ImpuestoAFIP")
				vRegistrosErrores[nRegs,13] = ThisForm.oView.Leer("Error")
			Endif
			ThisForm.oView.IrSiguiente()
		Enddo
		
		If nRegs<>0
			ThisForm.oFrmDobleControl = 3
			ThisForm.CrearYAsignarObjeto("ThisForm.oFrmDobleControl", "Tg_afip_doblecontrol", @vRegistrosErrores)
			ThisForm.oFrmDobleControl.Show()
		
			If ThisForm.oFrmDobleControl.Cancelado = .f.
				ThisForm.oFrmDobleControl.oAux_ComprobantesComprasAfip.IrPrimero()
				Do While !ThisForm.oFrmDobleControl.oAux_ComprobantesComprasAfip.EsEof()
					If !ThisForm.oFrmDobleControl.oAux_ComprobantesComprasAfip.Leer("Imprime")
						cClave = ThisForm.oFrmDobleControl.oAux_ComprobantesComprasAfip.Leer("Id_Sucursal") + ThisForm.oFrmDobleControl.oAux_ComprobantesComprasAfip.Leer("Id_Sistema") + ThisForm.oFrmDobleControl.oAux_ComprobantesComprasAfip.Leer("Id_Comproba") + Str(ThisForm.oFrmDobleControl.oAux_ComprobantesComprasAfip.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),10)+ThisForm.oFrmDobleControl.oAux_ComprobantesComprasAfip.Leer("Id")
						If ThisForm.oView.Localizar("Id_Sucursal+Id_Sistema+Id_Comproba+Str(Nro_Referencia,10)+Id='" + cClave + "'")
							=fGrabar(@vDatos, "Imprime", .f.)
							ThisForm.oView.Modificar(@vDatos, .f., .t.)
						Endif
					Endif			
					ThisForm.oFrmDobleControl.oAux_ComprobantesComprasAfip.IrSiguiente()
				Enddo
			Else
				lEmitir = .f.
			Endif
		Endif
		
		If lEmitir
			ThisForm.EmitirDisk()
			ThisForm.oCmdGenerarArchivoAFIP.Enabled = .f.
		Endif
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oGrdComprobantes.dblclickencelda

	ENDPROC

		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			If This.ConsultarMoneda()<>ThisForm.OldId_Moneda Or This.ConsultarTipoCotizacion()<>ThisForm.OldTipoCotizacion
				ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled = .t.
			Endif
		Endif
		ThisForm.OldId_Moneda				= This.ConsultarMoneda()
		ThisForm.OldTipoCotizacion			= This.ConsultarTipoCotizacion()
		ThisForm.oCmdImprimirGrilla.Enabled	= !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
	ENDPROC

	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxCatClienteDesde.LostFocus
		dodefault()
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled = This.Value<>ThisForm.OldCatClienteDesde
		Endif
		ThisForm.OldCatClienteDesde			= This.Value
		ThisForm.oTbxCatClienteHasta.Value	= This.Value
		ThisForm.OldCatClienteHasta			= This.Value
		ThisForm.oCmdImprimirGrilla.Enabled	= !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxCatClienteHasta.LostFocus
		dodefault()
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	= This.Value<>ThisForm.OldCatClienteHasta
			ThisForm.oCmdImprimirGrilla.Enabled		= !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
		Endif
		ThisForm.OldCatClienteHasta = This.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxCatProveedorDesde.LostFocus
		dodefault()

			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled = This.Value<>ThisForm.OldCatProveedorDesde
		Endif
		ThisForm.OldCatProveedorDesde			= This.Value
		ThisForm.oTbxCatProveedorHasta.Value	= This.Value
		ThisForm.OldCatProveedorHasta			= This.Value
		ThisForm.oCmdImprimirGrilla.Enabled		= !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxCatProveedorHasta.LostFocus
		dodefault()
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	= This.Value<>ThisForm.OldCatProveedorHasta
			ThisForm.oCmdImprimirGrilla.Enabled		= !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
		Endif	
		ThisForm.OldCatProveedorHasta = This.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxClienteDesde.LostFocus
		dodefault()
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled = This.Value<>ThisForm.OldId_ClienteDesde
		Endif
		ThisForm.OldId_ClienteDesde			= This.Value
		ThisForm.oTbxClienteHasta.Value		= This.Value
		ThisForm.OldId_ClienteHasta			= This.Value
		ThisForm.oCmdImprimirGrilla.Enabled	= !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxClienteHasta.LostFocus
		dodefault()
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	= This.Value<>ThisForm.OldId_ClienteHasta
			ThisForm.oCmdImprimirGrilla.Enabled		= !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
		Endif
		ThisForm.OldId_ClienteHasta = This.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxFechaDesde.LostFocus
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	= This.Value<>ThisForm.OldFechaDesde
			ThisForm.oCmdImprimirGrilla.Enabled		= !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
		Endif
		ThisForm.OldFechaDesde = This.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxFechaHasta.LostFocus
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	= This.Value<>ThisForm.OldFechaHasta
			ThisForm.oCmdImprimirGrilla.Enabled		= !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
		Endif	
		ThisForm.OldFechaHasta = This.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxProveedorDesde.LostFocus
		dodefault()
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled = This.Value<>ThisForm.OldId_ProveedorDesde
		Endif
		ThisForm.OldId_ProveedorDesde		= This.Value
		ThisForm.oTbxProveedorHasta.Value	= This.Value
		ThisForm.OldId_ProveedorHasta		= This.Value
		ThisForm.oCmdImprimirGrilla.Enabled	= !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxProveedorHasta.LostFocus
		dodefault()
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	= This.Value<>ThisForm.OldId_ProveedorHasta
			ThisForm.oCmdImprimirGrilla.Enabled		= !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
		Endif
		ThisForm.OldId_ProveedorHasta = This.Value
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

	PROCEDURE cargarestadoscolores
		local mmpp, cShape, cDesc, cHidden
		
		ThisForm.nErrores = 0
		mmpp = 0
		
		ThisForm.oTblErroresCitiCompras.IrPrimero()
		Do While !ThisForm.oTblErroresCitiCompras.EsEof()
		
			mmpp = mmpp + 1
		
			cShape	= "oShp" + allt(str(mmpp))
			cDesc	= "oDesc" + allt(str(mmpp))
			cHidden	= "oHidden" + allt(str(mmpp))
		
			if type("ThisForm." + cShape) = "U"
				ThisForm.AddObject(cShape, "tg_3dShape")
			endif
		
			ThisForm.&cShape..Left		= 12
			ThisForm.&cShape..Top		= 295 + ((mmpp - 1) * 16)
			ThisForm.&cShape..Width		= 15
			ThisForm.&cShape..Height	= 15
			ThisForm.&cShape..BackColor	= ThisForm.oTblErroresCitiCompras.Leer("Color")
			ThisForm.&cShape..BackStyle	= 1
			ThisForm.&cShape..Visible	= .t.
		
			if type("ThisForm." + cDesc) = "U"
				ThisForm.AddObject(cDesc, "tg_label")
			endif
		
			ThisForm.&cDesc..Left		= 40
			ThisForm.&cDesc..Top		= 295 + ((mmpp - 1) * 16)
			ThisForm.&cDesc..AutoSize	= .t.
			ThisForm.&cDesc..Caption	= Allt(ThisForm.oTblErroresCitiCompras.Leer("Descripcion"))
			ThisForm.&cDesc..Visible	= .t.
		
			if type("ThisForm." + cHidden) = "U"
				ThisForm.AddObject(cHidden, "tg_label")
			endif
		
			ThisForm.&cHidden..Caption = allt(ThisForm.oTblErroresCitiCompras.Leer("Validar1")) + allt(ThisForm.oTblErroresCitiCompras.Leer("Validar2"))
		
			ThisForm.oTblErroresCitiCompras.IrSiguiente()
		Enddo
		
		ThisForm.nErrores = mmpp
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE getcolorestado
		lParameter nError
		Local cColor, nColor
		
		if nError=0
			return rgb(255,255,255)
		else
			cColor = "ThisForm.oShp" + allt(str(nError)) + ".Backcolor"
			return &cColor
		endif
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE iniciarcomponentes
		Local mmpp
		
		ThisForm.CargarEstadosColores()
		
		ThisForm.oGrdComprobantes.Column9.CurrentControl	= "TG_CHECKBOX1"
		ThisForm.oGrdComprobantes.Column9.Sparse			= .f.
		ThisForm.oGrdComprobantes.Column9.ReadOnly			= .f.
		
		for mmpp=1 to ThisForm.oGrdComprobantes.ColumnCount
			ThisForm.oGrdComprobantes.Columns(mmpp).DynamicBackColor = "ThisForm.GetColorEstado(ThisForm.oAux_ComprobantesComprasAfip.Leer('Error'))"
		endfor
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		lparameters vRegistrosErrores
		
		dodefault()
		
		ThisForm.SetearHelpConTextId("ConsultaCompras")
		
		ThisForm.AddObject("oTblErroresCitiCompras"			,"Tg_tabla", "ErroresCitiCompras", "Clave")
		ThisForm.AddObject("oAux_ComprobantesComprasAfip"	,"Tg_tabla", "Aux_ComprobantesComprasAfip")
		
		ThisForm.oAux_ComprobantesComprasAfip.SetearProp("BOT")
		ThisForm.oAux_ComprobantesComprasAfip.Revertir()
		
		ThisForm.oGrdComprobantes.RecordSource = ThisForm.oAux_ComprobantesComprasAfip.Alias
		
		ThisForm.IniciarComponentes()
		
		ThisForm.RefrescarGrilla(@vRegistrosErrores)
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla
		lparameters vRegistrosErrores
		local i, vDatos[1,2]
		
		for i=1 to alen(vRegistrosErrores,1)
			=fGrabar(@vDatos, "Id_Sucursal"		,vRegistrosErrores[i,1])
			=fGrabar(@vDatos, "Id_Sistema"		,vRegistrosErrores[i,2])
			=fGrabar(@vDatos, "Id_Comproba"		,vRegistrosErrores[i,3])
			=fGrabar(@vDatos, "Nro_Referencia"	,vRegistrosErrores[i,4])
			=fGrabar(@vDatos, "Nro_Externo"		,vRegistrosErrores[i,5])
			=fGrabar(@vDatos, "Fecha"			,vRegistrosErrores[i,6])
			=fGrabar(@vDatos, "Total"			,vRegistrosErrores[i,7])
			=fGrabar(@vDatos, "Id"				,vRegistrosErrores[i,8])
			=fGrabar(@vDatos, "Nombre"			,vRegistrosErrores[i,9])
			=fGrabar(@vDatos, "Imprime"			,vRegistrosErrores[i,10])
			=fGrabar(@vDatos, "IVAAFIP"			,vRegistrosErrores[i,11])
			=fGrabar(@vDatos, "ImpuestoAFIP"	,vRegistrosErrores[i,12])
			=fGrabar(@vDatos, "Error"			,vRegistrosErrores[i,13])
			
			ThisForm.oAux_ComprobantesComprasAfip.AgregarYModificar(@vDatos,.t.)
		endfor
		
		ThisForm.oAux_ComprobantesComprasAfip.IrPrimero()
		
		ThisForm.SetearCursorEspera()
		
		ThisForm.oGrdComprobantes.RecordSource = ""
		ThisForm.oGrdComprobantes.RecordSource = ThisForm.oAux_ComprobantesComprasAfip.Alias
		
		ThisForm.oGrdComprobantes.Column1.ControlSource		= ThisForm.oAux_ComprobantesComprasAfip.Alias + ".Id_sucursal"
		ThisForm.oGrdComprobantes.Column2.ControlSource		= ThisForm.oAux_ComprobantesComprasAfip.Alias + ".Id_Comproba"
		ThisForm.oGrdComprobantes.Column3.ControlSource		= ThisForm.oAux_ComprobantesComprasAfip.Alias + ".Nro_Referencia"
		ThisForm.oGrdComprobantes.Column4.ControlSource		= ThisForm.oAux_ComprobantesComprasAfip.Alias + ".Nro_externo"
		ThisForm.oGrdComprobantes.Column5.ControlSource		= ThisForm.oAux_ComprobantesComprasAfip.Alias + ".Fecha"
		ThisForm.oGrdComprobantes.Column6.ControlSource		= ThisForm.oAux_ComprobantesComprasAfip.Alias + ".Total"
		ThisForm.oGrdComprobantes.Column7.ControlSource		= ThisForm.oAux_ComprobantesComprasAfip.Alias + ".Id"
		ThisForm.oGrdComprobantes.Column8.ControlSource		= ThisForm.oAux_ComprobantesComprasAfip.Alias + ".Nombre"
		ThisForm.oGrdComprobantes.Column9.ControlSource		= ThisForm.oAux_ComprobantesComprasAfip.Alias + ".Imprime"
		ThisForm.oGrdComprobantes.Column11.ControlSource	= ThisForm.oAux_ComprobantesComprasAfip.Alias + ".IvaAFIP"
		ThisForm.oGrdComprobantes.Column12.ControlSource	= ThisForm.oAux_ComprobantesComprasAfip.Alias + ".ImpuestoAFIP"
		
		ThisForm.oGrdComprobantes.Refresh()
		
		ThisForm.DessetearCursorEspera()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdAceptar.Click
		ThisForm.Cancelado = .f.
		ThisForm.Hide()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdCerrar.Click
		ThisForm.Cancelado = .t.
		ThisForm.Hide()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oGrdComprobantes.dblclickencelda
		ThisForm.MostrarComprobante()
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

	PROCEDURE agregarpallet

	PROCEDURE anularlectura
		
		If oApp.PedirPermiso("CON","TG_ALTAPALLET","ANULARLECTURAPALLET",oApp.CodSistema("Compras"),oApp.Usuario) 
		
			If fMensPregunto("¿Desea anular la lectura del pallet? (Se anularan los movimientos de stock. Continuar","S")="S"
				oApp.ComenzarTransaccion(thisform.DataSessionId)
		
				If Thisform.oTblPrdDetalle.Buscar(Thisform.Tg_TextBox1.Value, .F., "NRO_PALLET")
					If !Thisform.oTblPrdDetalle.Leer("Anulado")
						If Thisform.oTblPrdDetalle.Leer("Id_Estado") = 2 
							If Thisform.oCstSistemaStock.Anular(Thisform.oTblPrdDetalle.Leer("Id_Suc_Stock"),Thisform.oTblPrdDetalle.Leer("Id_Sis_Stock"),Thisform.oTblPrdDetalle.Leer("Id_Com_Stock"),Thisform.oTblPrdDetalle.Leer("Nro_Ref_Stock"),Thisform.oTblPrdDetalle.Leer("Id_Sis_Stock"))						
					
								=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_Sucursal"		, Thisform.Id_Sucursal)
								=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_Sistema"		, Thisform.Id_Sistema)
								=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_Comproba"		, Thisform.Id_Comproba)
								=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Nro_Referencia"	, Thisform.Nro_Referencia)
								=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Nro_Cierre"		, Thisform.Nro_Cierre)
								=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Nro_Pallet"		, Thisform.oTblPrdDetalle.Leer("Nro_Pallet"))
								=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_Usuario"		, oApp.Usuario)
								=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Maquina"			, oApp.Maquina)
								=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Hora"				, Time())
								=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Fecha_Clock"		, Date())		
								=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Detalle"			, "Anulación de lectura.")			
								Thisform.oTblLogEstadoPallet.AgregarYModificar(@vGrabacion,.t.)	
								
								=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_Suc_Stock"		, "")
								=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_Sis_Stock"		, "")
								=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_Com_Stock"		, "")
								=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Nro_Ref_Stock"	, 0)	
								=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_Estado"		, 1)	
								=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_Usuario_Leido"	, "")
								=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Maquina_Leido"	, "")
								=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Hora_Leido"		, "")
								=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Fecha_Clock_Leido", ctod("  /  /    "))								
								Thisform.oTblPrdDetalle.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)	
								
								=FMensAceptar("Se anulo la lectura correctamente.")
							Endif
						Else
							=FMensAceptar("No se puede realizar la anulación porque el pallet no fue leído.")					
						Endif
					Endif
				Endif
		
				Thisform.Tg_BtnAnularLectura.Enabled = .F.		
				
				oApp.FinalizarTransaccion(thisform.DataSessionId)
				oApp.RefrescarAplicacion	
			Endif
		Else	
			=FMensAceptar ("Su nivel de seguridad no permite anular el pallet.")
		Endif	
		
		
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE anularpallet
		Local nCantidad
		
		nCantidad = 0
		
		If oApp.PedirPermiso("CON","TG_ALTAPALLET","ANULARPALLET" ,oApp.CodSistema("Compras"),oApp.Usuario) 
		
			If fMensPregunto("¿Desea anular el pallet?. Continuar","S")="S"
			
				oApp.ComenzarTransaccion(thisform.DataSessionId)
		
				If Thisform.oTblPrdCabecera.Buscar(Thisform.Id_Sucursal+Thisform.Id_Sistema+Thisform.Id_Comproba+Str(Thisform.Nro_Referencia,10)+Str(Thisform.Nro_Cierre,2), .F., "CLAVE")
					If Thisform.oTblPrdDetalle.Buscar(Thisform.Tg_TextBox1.Value, .F., "NRO_PALLET")
						If !Thisform.oTblPrdDetalle.Leer("Anulado")
							If Thisform.oTblPrdDetalle.Leer("Id_Estado") = 2 
								=FMensAceptar ("Para anular el pallet primeros se debe anular la lectura del mismo.")
							Else
								=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Anulado" 				, .T.)
								=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_Usuario_Anulo"		, oApp.Usuario)
								=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Maquina_Anulo"		, oApp.Maquina)
								=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Hora_Anulo"			, Time())
								=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Fecha_Clock_Anulo"	, Date())	
								=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"obsanulacion"			, Alltrim(ThisForm.oEdtObservaciones.Value))
								Thisform.oTblPrdDetalle.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)	
								
								=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_Sucursal"			, Thisform.Id_Sucursal)
								=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_Sistema"			, Thisform.Id_Sistema)
								=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_Comproba"			, Thisform.Id_Comproba)
								=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Nro_Referencia"		, Thisform.Nro_Referencia)
								=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Nro_Cierre"			, Thisform.Nro_Cierre)
								=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Nro_Pallet" 			, Thisform.oTblPrdDetalle.Leer("Nro_Pallet"))
								=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_Usuario"			, oApp.Usuario)
								=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Maquina"				, oApp.Maquina)
								=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Hora"					, Time())
								=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Fecha_Clock"			, Date())		
								=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Detalle"				, "Anulación de pallet.")			
								Thisform.oTblLogEstadoPallet.AgregarYModificar(@vGrabacion,.t.)	
		
								nCantidad = Thisform.oTblPrdDetalle.Leer("Cantidad")
		
								=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"CantidadSaldo"		, Thisform.oTblPrdCabecera.Leer("CantidadSaldo") + nCantidad)		
								Thisform.oTblPrdCabecera.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)	
		
								Thisform.Tg_BtnAnularPallet.Enabled = .F.
								
								=FMensAceptar("Se anulo el pallet correctamente.")
							Endif
						Endif
					Endif
				Endif	
					
				oApp.FinalizarTransaccion(thisform.DataSessionId)
				oApp.RefrescarAplicacion	
			Endif
		Else	
			=FMensAceptar ("Su nivel de seguridad no permite anular el pallet.")
		Endif	
		
		
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE cancelar
		dodefault()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE cargardatosdelpallet
		lParameters nNroPallet
		
		If Thisform.oTblPrdDetalle.Buscar(nNroPallet, .F., "Nro_Pallet")
			Thisform.Tg_TextBox1.Value = Thisform.oTblPrdDetalle.Leer("Nro_Pallet")
			Thisform.Tg_TextBox3.Value = Thisform.oTblPrdDetalle.Leer("Bultos")
			Thisform.Tg_TextBox4.Value = Thisform.oTblPrdDetalle.Leer("Vencimiento")
			Thisform.Tg_TextBox5.Value = Thisform.oTblPrdDetalle.Leer("Lote")
			Thisform.Tg_TextBox6.Value = Thisform.oTblPrdDetalle.Leer("ObsEtiqueta")
			Thisform.Tg_TextBox7.Value = Thisform.oTblPrdDetalle.Leer("Cantidad")
			
			ThisForm.Tg_btnAnularPallet.Enabled  = !Thisform.Edicion And !Thisform.oTblPrdDetalle.Leer("Anulado")
			ThisForm.Tg_btnAnularLectura.Enabled = !Thisform.Edicion And !Thisform.oTblPrdDetalle.Leer("Anulado") And Thisform.oTblPrdDetalle.Leer("Id_Estado")=2
		Endif
		
		
			
					
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE grabarpallet
		Local vGrabacion, lAlta
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		lAlta = .F.
		
		If Thisform.Tg_textBox1.Value < Thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("Nro_Pallet")
			Thisform.Tg_textBox1.Value = Thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("Nro_Pallet")
			=fMensAceptar("El Nro. de pallet ha cambiado.")
		Endif
		
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Nro_Pallet" 		, Thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("Nro_Pallet")+1)
		Thisform.oTblParametros.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)
		
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_Sucursal"		, Thisform.Id_Sucursal)
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_Sistema"		, Thisform.Id_Sistema)	
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_Comproba"		, Thisform.Id_Comproba)	
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Nro_Referencia"	, Thisform.Nro_Referencia)	
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_Articulo" 		, Thisform.Tg_Articulos1.Value)
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Detalle"	 		, Thisform.Tg_textBox2.Value)
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Cantidad"	 		, Thisform.Tg_textBox7.Value)
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_Usuario"		, oApp.Usuario)
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Maquina"			, oApp.Maquina)
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Hora"				, Time())
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Fecha_Clock"		, Date())
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Bultos"	 		, Thisform.Tg_textBox3.Value)
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Vencimiento" 		, Thisform.Tg_textBox4.Value)
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Lote"	 			, Thisform.Tg_textBox5.Value)
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"ObsEtiqueta" 		, Thisform.Tg_textBox6.Value)
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Nro_Pallet" 		, Thisform.Tg_textBox1.Value)
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Nro_Cierre" 		, Thisform.Nro_Cierre)
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_Estado" 		, 0)
		Thisform.oTblPrdDetalle.AgregarYModificar(@vGrabacion,.t.)
		
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_Sucursal"		, Thisform.Id_Sucursal)
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_Sistema"		, Thisform.Id_Sistema)
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_Comproba"		, Thisform.Id_Comproba)
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Nro_Referencia"	, Thisform.Nro_Referencia)
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Nro_Cierre"		, Thisform.Nro_Cierre)
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Nro_Pallet" 		, Thisform.Tg_textBox1.Value)
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_Usuario"		, oApp.Usuario)
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Maquina"			, oApp.Maquina)
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Hora"				, Time())
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Fecha_Clock"		, Date())		
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Detalle"			, "Alta de pallet.")			
		Thisform.oTblLogEstadoPallet.AgregarYModificar(@vGrabacion,.t.)	
		
		If Thisform.oTblPrdCabecera.Buscar(Thisform.Id_Sucursal+Thisform.Id_Sistema+Thisform.Id_Comproba+Str(Thisform.Nro_Referencia,10)+Str(Thisform.Nro_Cierre,2), .F., "CLAVE")
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"CantidadSaldo" 	, Thisform.oTblPrdCabecera.Leer("CantidadSaldo") - Thisform.Tg_textBox7.Value)
			Thisform.oTblPrdCabecera.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)
			
			If Thisform.oTblPrdCabecera.Leer("CantidadSaldo") = 0
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Cerrado" 		, .T.)
				Thisform.oTblPrdCabecera.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)
			Endif 	
		Endif
		
		Thisform.InicializarComponentes(lAlta)
		Thisform.RefrescarConsulta()
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE inicializarcomponentes
		lParameters lAlta
		
		Thisform.Tg_TextBox1.Value = Iif(lAlta,Thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("Nro_Pallet"),0)
		Thisform.Tg_TextBox4.Value = cTod("  /  /    ")
		Thisform.Tg_TextBox5.Value = ""
		Thisform.Tg_TextBox6.Value = ""
		Thisform.Tg_TextBox7.Value = Iif(lAlta, Thisform.Tg_TextBox8.Value - Thisform.Tg_TextBox9.Value,0)
		Thisform.Tg_TextBox3.Value = Iif(lAlta, Iif(Thisform.Tg_TextBox7.Value=0, 0, Thisform.Tg_TextBox7.Value / Thisform.Coef_Uni_Med2),0)
		
		Thisform.Tg_TextBox4.Enabled = lAlta
		Thisform.Tg_TextBox5.Enabled = lAlta
		Thisform.Tg_TextBox6.Enabled = lAlta
		Thisform.Tg_TextBox7.Enabled = lAlta
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		lParameters cId_Sucursal, cId_Sistema, cId_Comproba, nNro_Referencia, nNro_Cierre, lEdicion, nNroPallet
		Local lAlta
		
		Dodefault()
		
		Thisform.Id_Sucursal 	= cId_Sucursal
		Thisform.Id_Comproba 	= cId_Comproba
		Thisform.Id_Sistema  	= cId_Sistema
		Thisform.Nro_Referencia = nNro_Referencia
		Thisform.Nro_Cierre		= nNro_Cierre
		Thisform.Edicion		= lEdicion
		
		Thisform.AddObject("oTblParametros"			,"tg_tabla","Parametros")
		Thisform.AddObject("oTblArticulos"			,"tg_tabla","Articulos"			,"clave")
		Thisform.AddObject("oTblPrdCabecera"		,"tg_tabla","Prd_CabeceraOP"	,"clave")
		Thisform.AddObject("oTblPrdDetalle"			,"tg_tabla","Prd_DetalleOP"		,"Nro_Pallet")
		Thisform.AddObject("oTblLogEstadoPallet"	,"tg_tabla","Log_EstadoPallet"	,"CLAVE")
		Thisform.AddObject("oViewDetallePallets"	,"tg_viewDetallePallets")
		Thisform.AddObject("oCstSistemaStock"		,"tg_sistemastock")
		
		lAlta = .F.
		
		Thisform.Height = 506 &&& 27-09-2022
		
		
		
		Thisform.Tg_btnAgregar.Enabled   	 = Thisform.Edicion
		
		If Thisform.oTblPrdCabecera.Buscar(Thisform.Id_Sucursal+Thisform.Id_Sistema+Thisform.Id_Comproba+Str(Thisform.Nro_Referencia,10)+Str(Thisform.Nro_Cierre,2), .F., "CLAVE")
			Thisform.Articulo				 = Thisform.oTblPrdCabecera.Leer("Id_Articulo")
			Thisform.tg_Articulos1.Value	 = Thisform.Articulo
			Thisform.tg_articulos1.enabled	 = .f.
			Thisform.tg_articulos1.BackStyle = 0
			Thisform.tg_articulos1.DisabledForeColor=RGB(0,0,0)
			
			Thisform.Tg_TextBox8.Value = Thisform.oTblPrdCabecera.Leer("CantidadOriginal")
			Thisform.Tg_TextBox9.Value = Thisform.oTblPrdCabecera.Leer("CantidadOriginal")-Thisform.oTblPrdCabecera.Leer("CantidadSaldo")
			
			Thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource = thisform.oViewDetallePallets.Alias
			
			If Thisform.oTblArticulos.Buscar(Thisform.oTblPrdCabecera.Leer("Id_Articulo"), .F., "CLAVE")
				Thisform.Coef_Uni_Med2			 = Iif(Thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Coef_Uni_Med2")=0, 1, Thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Coef_Uni_Med2"))
				Thisform.tg_textbox2.Value	 	 = Thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Nombre")
				Thisform.tg_textbox2.enabled	 = .f.
				Thisform.tg_textbox2.BackStyle	 = 0
				Thisform.tg_textbox2.DisabledForeColor=RGB(0,0,0)
			Else
				Thisform.Coef_Uni_Med2	= 1
			Endif
			
			ThisForm.Tg_btnAnularPallet.Enabled  = !Thisform.Edicion And !Thisform.oTblPrdCabecera.Leer("Anulado")
			ThisForm.Tg_btnAnularLectura.Enabled = !Thisform.Edicion And !Thisform.oTblPrdCabecera.Leer("Anulado")
			
			If Thisform.Edicion	
				Thisform.InicializarComponentes(lAlta)
				Thisform.RefrescarConsulta()
			Else
				Thisform.CargarDatosDelPallet(nNroPallet)	
			Endif
		Endif
					
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarconsulta
		Thisform.LockScreen=.t.
		ThisForm.SetearCursorEspera()
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource = ""
		thisform.oViewDetallePallets.Refrescar(Thisform.Id_Sucursal,Thisform.Id_Sistema,Thisform.Id_Comproba,Thisform.Nro_Referencia,Thisform.Nro_Cierre)
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource = thisform.oViewDetallePallets.Alias
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource =thisform.oViewDetallePallets.Alias + ".Fecha"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource =thisform.oViewDetallePallets.Alias + ".Nro_Pallet"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource =thisform.oViewDetallePallets.Alias + ".Cantidad"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column4.ControlSource =thisform.oViewDetallePallets.Alias + ".Bultos"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column5.ControlSource =thisform.oViewDetallePallets.Alias + ".Vencimiento"
		
		Thisform.Tg_TextBox9.Value = Thisform.oViewDetallePallets.Sumar("Cantidad",".t.")
		
		Thisform.tg_grid1.Refresh()
		
		ThisForm.DesSetearCursorEspera()
		Thisform.LockScreen=.f.
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE validar
		Local lContinua
		
		lContinua = .T.
		
		If lContinua And Empty(Thisform.Tg_Textbox1.Value)
			lContinua = .F.
			=fMensAceptar("El número de pallet no esta cargado.")
		Endif
		
		If lContinua And Thisform.Tg_Textbox7.Value=0
			lContinua = .F.
			=fMensAceptar("Las unidades de pallet no pueden quedar en 0.")
		Endif
		
		If lContinua And Empty(Thisform.Tg_Textbox4.Value)
			lContinua = .F.
			=fMensAceptar("El vencimiento no puede quedar vacío.")
		Endif
		
		If lContinua And Empty(Thisform.Tg_Textbox5.Value)
			lContinua = .F.
			=fMensAceptar("El lote no puede quedar vacío.")
		Endif
		
		If Thisform.Tg_Textbox7.Value<>0
			 Thisform.Tg_Textbox3.Value = Round(Thisform.Tg_Textbox7.Value / Thisform.Coef_Uni_Med2,2)
		Endif
		
		If lContinua And Thisform.Tg_Textbox3.Value=0
			lContinua = .F.
			=fMensAceptar("La cantidad de bultos no puede quedar en 0.")
		Endif
		
		
		If lContinua And Thisform.Tg_TextBox7.Value > (Thisform.Tg_TextBox8.Value - Thisform.Tg_TextBox9.Value)
			lContinua = .F.
			=fMensAceptar("La cantidad de unidades no puede ser mayor a " + Str(Thisform.Tg_TextBox8.Value - Thisform.Tg_TextBox9.Value,15,5) + ".")
		Endif
		
		If lContinua And Thisform.Tg_TextBox7.Value < 0
			lContinua = .F.
			=fMensAceptar("La cantidad de unidades no puede menor a 1.")
			
		Endif}
		Return lContinua
	ENDPROC

			thisform.GrabarPallet()
			This.Enabled = .F.
			Thisform.Tg_btnAgregar.Enabled  = .T.
			Thisform.Tg_btnDeshacer.Enabled = .F.
		Endif
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_btnGrabarAnulacion.Click
		If Empty(ThisForm.oEdtObservaciones.Value)
			=fMensAceptar("Debe completar las observaciones de anulación!!!")
		Else
			Thisform.AnularPallet()
			***ThisForm.Height = 400 &&& 27-09-2022
			ThisForm.Tg_btnGrabarAnulacion.Enabled = .F.
			Thisform.oEdtObservaciones.Enabled = .F.
		Endif
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_textbox7.LostFocus
		If This.Value<>0
			 Thisform.Tg_Textbox3.Value = Round(This.Value / Thisform.Coef_Uni_Med2,2)
		Endif
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_textbox7.Valid
		If This.Value<>0
			 Thisform.Tg_Textbox3.Value = Round(This.Value / Thisform.Coef_Uni_Med2,2)
		Endif
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_textbox7.When
		If This.Value<>0
			 Thisform.Tg_Textbox3.Value = Round(This.Value / Thisform.Coef_Uni_Med2,2)
		Endif
		
		
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

	PROCEDURE agregarpallet
		Local lAlta
		
		lAlta = .T.
		
		Thisform.InicializarComponentes(lAlta)
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE anularlectura
		
		If oApp.PedirPermiso("CON","TG_ALTAPALLET","ANULARLECTURAPALLET",oApp.CodSistema("Compras"),oApp.Usuario) 
		
			If fMensPregunto("¿Desea anular la lectura del pallet? (Se anularan los movimientos de stock. Continuar","S")="S"
				oApp.ComenzarTransaccion(thisform.DataSessionId)
		
				If Thisform.oTblPrdDetalle.Buscar(Thisform.Tg_TextBox1.Value, .F., "NRO_PALLET")
					If !Thisform.oTblPrdDetalle.Leer("Anulado")
						If Thisform.oTblPrdDetalle.Leer("Id_Estado") = 2 
							If Thisform.oCstSistemaStock.Anular(Thisform.oTblPrdDetalle.Leer("Id_Suc_Stock"),Thisform.oTblPrdDetalle.Leer("Id_Sis_Stock"),Thisform.oTblPrdDetalle.Leer("Id_Com_Stock"),Thisform.oTblPrdDetalle.Leer("Nro_Ref_Stock"),Thisform.oTblPrdDetalle.Leer("Id_Sis_Stock"))						
					
								=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_Sucursal"		, Thisform.Id_Sucursal)
								=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_Sistema"		, Thisform.Id_Sistema)
								=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_Comproba"		, Thisform.Id_Comproba)
								=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Nro_Referencia"	, Thisform.Nro_Referencia)
								=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Nro_Cierre"		, Thisform.Nro_Cierre)
								=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Nro_Pallet"		, Thisform.oTblPrdDetalle.Leer("Nro_Pallet"))
								=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_Usuario"		, oApp.Usuario)
								=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Maquina"			, oApp.Maquina)
								=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Hora"				, Time())
								=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Fecha_Clock"		, Date())		
								=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Detalle"			, "Anulación de lectura.")			
								Thisform.oTblLogEstadoPallet.AgregarYModificar(@vGrabacion,.t.)	
								
								=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_Suc_Stock"		, "")
								=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_Sis_Stock"		, "")
								=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_Com_Stock"		, "")
								=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Nro_Ref_Stock"	, 0)	
								=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_Estado"		, 1)	
								=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_Usuario_Leido"	, "")
								=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Maquina_Leido"	, "")
								=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Hora_Leido"		, "")
								=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Fecha_Clock_Leido", ctod("  /  /    "))								
								Thisform.oTblPrdDetalle.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)	
								
								=FMensAceptar("Se anulo la lectura correctamente.")
							Endif
						Else
							=FMensAceptar("No se puede realizar la anulación porque el pallet no fue leído.")					
						Endif
					Endif
				Endif
		
				Thisform.Tg_BtnAnularLectura.Enabled = .F.		
				
				oApp.FinalizarTransaccion(thisform.DataSessionId)
				oApp.RefrescarAplicacion	
			Endif
		Else	
			=FMensAceptar ("Su nivel de seguridad no permite anular el pallet.")
		Endif	
		
		
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE anularpallet
		Local nCantidad
		
		nCantidad = 0
		
		If oApp.PedirPermiso("CON","TG_ALTAPALLET","ANULARPALLET" ,oApp.CodSistema("Compras"),oApp.Usuario) 
		
			If fMensPregunto("¿Desea anular el pallet?. Continuar","S")="S"
			
				oApp.ComenzarTransaccion(thisform.DataSessionId)
		
				If Thisform.oTblPrdCabecera.Buscar(Thisform.Id_Sucursal+Thisform.Id_Sistema+Thisform.Id_Comproba+Str(Thisform.Nro_Referencia,10)+Str(Thisform.Nro_Cierre,2), .F., "CLAVE")
					If Thisform.oTblPrdDetalle.Buscar(Thisform.Tg_TextBox1.Value, .F., "NRO_PALLET")
						If !Thisform.oTblPrdDetalle.Leer("Anulado")
							If Thisform.oTblPrdDetalle.Leer("Id_Estado") = 2 
								=FMensAceptar ("Para anular el pallet primeros se debe anular la lectura del mismo.")
							Else
								=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Anulado" 				, .T.)
								=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_Usuario_Anulo"		, oApp.Usuario)
								=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Maquina_Anulo"		, oApp.Maquina)
								=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Hora_Anulo"			, Time())
								=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Fecha_Clock_Anulo"	, Date())	
								=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"obsanulacion"			, Alltrim(ThisForm.oEdtObservaciones.Value))
								Thisform.oTblPrdDetalle.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)	
								
								=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_Sucursal"			, Thisform.Id_Sucursal)
								=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_Sistema"			, Thisform.Id_Sistema)
								=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_Comproba"			, Thisform.Id_Comproba)
								=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Nro_Referencia"		, Thisform.Nro_Referencia)
								=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Nro_Cierre"			, Thisform.Nro_Cierre)
								=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Nro_Pallet" 			, Thisform.oTblPrdDetalle.Leer("Nro_Pallet"))
								=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_Usuario"			, oApp.Usuario)
								=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Maquina"				, oApp.Maquina)
								=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Hora"					, Time())
								=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Fecha_Clock"			, Date())		
								=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Detalle"				, "Anulación de pallet.")			
								Thisform.oTblLogEstadoPallet.AgregarYModificar(@vGrabacion,.t.)	
		
								nCantidad = Thisform.oTblPrdDetalle.Leer("Cantidad")
		
								=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"CantidadSaldo"		, Thisform.oTblPrdCabecera.Leer("CantidadSaldo") + nCantidad)		
								Thisform.oTblPrdCabecera.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)	
		
								Thisform.Tg_BtnAnularPallet.Enabled = .F.
								
								=FMensAceptar("Se anulo el pallet correctamente.")
							Endif
						Endif
					Endif
				Endif	
					
				oApp.FinalizarTransaccion(thisform.DataSessionId)
				oApp.RefrescarAplicacion	
			Endif
		Else	
			=FMensAceptar ("Su nivel de seguridad no permite anular el pallet.")
		Endif	
		
		
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE cancelar
		dodefault()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE cargardatosdelpallet
		lParameters nNroPallet
		
		If Thisform.oTblPrdDetalle.Buscar(nNroPallet, .F., "Nro_Pallet")
			Thisform.Tg_TextBox1.Value = Thisform.oTblPrdDetalle.Leer("Nro_Pallet")
			Thisform.Tg_TextBox3.Value = Thisform.oTblPrdDetalle.Leer("Bultos")
			Thisform.Tg_TextBox4.Value = Thisform.oTblPrdDetalle.Leer("Vencimiento")
			Thisform.Tg_TextBox5.Value = Thisform.oTblPrdDetalle.Leer("Lote")
			Thisform.Tg_TextBox6.Value = Thisform.oTblPrdDetalle.Leer("ObsEtiqueta")
			Thisform.Tg_TextBox7.Value = Thisform.oTblPrdDetalle.Leer("Cantidad")
			
			ThisForm.Tg_btnAnularPallet.Enabled  = !Thisform.Edicion And !Thisform.oTblPrdDetalle.Leer("Anulado")
			ThisForm.Tg_btnAnularLectura.Enabled = !Thisform.Edicion And !Thisform.oTblPrdDetalle.Leer("Anulado") And Thisform.oTblPrdDetalle.Leer("Id_Estado")=2
		Endif
		
		
			
					
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE consultarbonivolumen
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE consultarprecioportalle
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE consultarpreciovolumen
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE grabarlistas
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE grabarpallet
		Local vGrabacion, lAlta
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		lAlta = .F.
		
		If Thisform.Tg_textBox1.Value < Thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("Nro_Pallet")
			Thisform.Tg_textBox1.Value = Thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("Nro_Pallet")
			=fMensAceptar("El Nro. de pallet ha cambiado.")
		Endif
		
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Nro_Pallet" 		, Thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("Nro_Pallet")+1)
		Thisform.oTblParametros.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)
		
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_Sucursal"		, Thisform.Id_Sucursal)
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_Sistema"		, Thisform.Id_Sistema)	
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_Comproba"		, Thisform.Id_Comproba)	
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Nro_Referencia"	, Thisform.Nro_Referencia)	
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_Articulo" 		, Thisform.Tg_Articulos1.Value)
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Detalle"	 		, Thisform.Tg_textBox2.Value)
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Cantidad"	 		, Thisform.Tg_textBox7.Value)
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_Usuario"		, oApp.Usuario)
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Maquina"			, oApp.Maquina)
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Hora"				, Time())
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Fecha_Clock"		, Date())
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Bultos"	 		, Thisform.Tg_textBox3.Value)
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Vencimiento" 		, Thisform.Tg_textBox4.Value)
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Lote"	 			, Thisform.Tg_textBox5.Value)
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"ObsEtiqueta" 		, Thisform.Tg_textBox6.Value)
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Nro_Pallet" 		, Thisform.Tg_textBox1.Value)
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Nro_Cierre" 		, Thisform.Nro_Cierre)
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_Estado" 		, 0)
		Thisform.oTblPrdDetalle.AgregarYModificar(@vGrabacion,.t.)
		
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_Sucursal"		, Thisform.Id_Sucursal)
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_Sistema"		, Thisform.Id_Sistema)
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_Comproba"		, Thisform.Id_Comproba)
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Nro_Referencia"	, Thisform.Nro_Referencia)
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Nro_Cierre"		, Thisform.Nro_Cierre)
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Nro_Pallet" 		, Thisform.Tg_textBox1.Value)
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_Usuario"		, oApp.Usuario)
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Maquina"			, oApp.Maquina)
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Hora"				, Time())
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Fecha_Clock"		, Date())		
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Detalle"			, "Alta de pallet.")			
		Thisform.oTblLogEstadoPallet.AgregarYModificar(@vGrabacion,.t.)	
		
		If Thisform.oTblPrdCabecera.Buscar(Thisform.Id_Sucursal+Thisform.Id_Sistema+Thisform.Id_Comproba+Str(Thisform.Nro_Referencia,10)+Str(Thisform.Nro_Cierre,2), .F., "CLAVE")
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"CantidadSaldo" 	, Thisform.oTblPrdCabecera.Leer("CantidadSaldo") - Thisform.Tg_textBox7.Value)
			Thisform.oTblPrdCabecera.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)
			
			If Thisform.oTblPrdCabecera.Leer("CantidadSaldo") = 0
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Cerrado" 		, .T.)
				Thisform.oTblPrdCabecera.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)
			Endif 	
		Endif
		
		Thisform.InicializarComponentes(lAlta)
		Thisform.RefrescarConsulta()
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE inicializarcomponentes
		lParameters lAlta
		
		Thisform.Tg_TextBox1.Value = Iif(lAlta,Thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("Nro_Pallet"),0)
		Thisform.Tg_TextBox4.Value = cTod("  /  /    ")
		Thisform.Tg_TextBox5.Value = ""
		Thisform.Tg_TextBox6.Value = ""
		Thisform.Tg_TextBox7.Value = Iif(lAlta, Thisform.Tg_TextBox8.Value - Thisform.Tg_TextBox9.Value,0)
		Thisform.Tg_TextBox3.Value = Iif(lAlta, Iif(Thisform.Tg_TextBox7.Value=0, 0, Thisform.Tg_TextBox7.Value / Thisform.Coef_Uni_Med2),0)
		
		Thisform.Tg_TextBox4.Enabled = lAlta
		Thisform.Tg_TextBox5.Enabled = lAlta
		Thisform.Tg_TextBox6.Enabled = lAlta
		Thisform.Tg_TextBox7.Enabled = lAlta
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		lParameters cId_Sucursal, cId_Sistema, cId_Comproba, nNro_Referencia, nNro_Cierre, lEdicion, nNroPallet
		Local lAlta
		
		Dodefault()
		
		Thisform.Id_Sucursal 	= cId_Sucursal
		Thisform.Id_Comproba 	= cId_Comproba
		Thisform.Id_Sistema  	= cId_Sistema
		Thisform.Nro_Referencia = nNro_Referencia
		Thisform.Nro_Cierre		= nNro_Cierre
		Thisform.Edicion		= lEdicion
		
		Thisform.AddObject("oTblParametros"			,"tg_tabla","Parametros")
		Thisform.AddObject("oTblArticulos"			,"tg_tabla","Articulos"			,"clave")
		Thisform.AddObject("oTblPrdCabecera"		,"tg_tabla","Prd_CabeceraOP"	,"clave")
		Thisform.AddObject("oTblPrdDetalle"			,"tg_tabla","Prd_DetalleOP"		,"Nro_Pallet")
		Thisform.AddObject("oTblLogEstadoPallet"	,"tg_tabla","Log_EstadoPallet"	,"CLAVE")
		Thisform.AddObject("oViewDetallePallets"	,"tg_viewDetallePallets")
		Thisform.AddObject("oCstSistemaStock"		,"tg_sistemastock")
		
		lAlta = .F.
		
		Thisform.Tg_btnAgregar.Enabled   	 = Thisform.Edicion
		
		If Thisform.oTblPrdCabecera.Buscar(Thisform.Id_Sucursal+Thisform.Id_Sistema+Thisform.Id_Comproba+Str(Thisform.Nro_Referencia,10)+Str(Thisform.Nro_Cierre,2), .F., "CLAVE")
			Thisform.Articulo				 = Thisform.oTblPrdCabecera.Leer("Id_Articulo")
			Thisform.tg_Articulos1.Value	 = Thisform.Articulo
			Thisform.tg_articulos1.enabled	 = .f.
			Thisform.tg_articulos1.BackStyle = 0
			Thisform.tg_articulos1.DisabledForeColor=RGB(0,0,0)
			
			Thisform.Tg_TextBox8.Value = Thisform.oTblPrdCabecera.Leer("CantidadOriginal")
			Thisform.Tg_TextBox9.Value = Thisform.oTblPrdCabecera.Leer("CantidadOriginal")-Thisform.oTblPrdCabecera.Leer("CantidadSaldo")
			
			Thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource = thisform.oViewDetallePallets.Alias
			
			If Thisform.oTblArticulos.Buscar(Thisform.oTblPrdCabecera.Leer("Id_Articulo"), .F., "CLAVE")
				Thisform.Coef_Uni_Med2			 = Iif(Thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Coef_Uni_Med2")=0, 1, Thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Coef_Uni_Med2"))
				Thisform.tg_textbox2.Value	 	 = Thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Nombre")
				Thisform.tg_textbox2.enabled	 = .f.
				Thisform.tg_textbox2.BackStyle	 = 0
				Thisform.tg_textbox2.DisabledForeColor=RGB(0,0,0)
			Else
				Thisform.Coef_Uni_Med2	= 1
			Endif
			
			ThisForm.Tg_btnAnularPallet.Enabled  = !Thisform.Edicion And !Thisform.oTblPrdCabecera.Leer("Anulado")
			ThisForm.Tg_btnAnularLectura.Enabled = !Thisform.Edicion And !Thisform.oTblPrdCabecera.Leer("Anulado")
			
			If Thisform.Edicion	
				Thisform.InicializarComponentes(lAlta)
				Thisform.RefrescarConsulta()
			Else
				Thisform.CargarDatosDelPallet(nNroPallet)	
			Endif
		Endif
					
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarconsulta
		Thisform.LockScreen=.t.
		ThisForm.SetearCursorEspera()
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource = ""
		thisform.oViewDetallePallets.Refrescar(Thisform.Id_Sucursal,Thisform.Id_Sistema,Thisform.Id_Comproba,Thisform.Nro_Referencia,Thisform.Nro_Cierre)
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource = thisform.oViewDetallePallets.Alias
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource =thisform.oViewDetallePallets.Alias + ".Fecha"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource =thisform.oViewDetallePallets.Alias + ".Nro_Pallet"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource =thisform.oViewDetallePallets.Alias + ".Cantidad"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column4.ControlSource =thisform.oViewDetallePallets.Alias + ".Bultos"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column5.ControlSource =thisform.oViewDetallePallets.Alias + ".Vencimiento"
		
		Thisform.Tg_TextBox9.Value = Thisform.oViewDetallePallets.Sumar("Cantidad",".t.")
		
		Thisform.tg_grid1.Refresh()
		
		ThisForm.DesSetearCursorEspera()
		Thisform.LockScreen=.f.
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE validar
		Local lContinua
		
		lContinua = .T.
		
		If lContinua And Empty(Thisform.Tg_Textbox1.Value)
			lContinua = .F.
			=fMensAceptar("El número de pallet no esta cargado.")
		Endif
		
		If lContinua And Thisform.Tg_Textbox7.Value=0
			lContinua = .F.
			=fMensAceptar("Las unidades de pallet no pueden quedar en 0.")
		Endif
		
		If lContinua And Empty(Thisform.Tg_Textbox4.Value)
			lContinua = .F.
			=fMensAceptar("El vencimiento no puede quedar vacío.")
		Endif
		
		If lContinua And Empty(Thisform.Tg_Textbox5.Value)
			lContinua = .F.
			=fMensAceptar("El lote no puede quedar vacío.")
		Endif
		
		If Thisform.Tg_Textbox7.Value<>0
			 Thisform.Tg_Textbox3.Value = Round(Thisform.Tg_Textbox7.Value / Thisform.Coef_Uni_Med2,2)
		Endif
		
		If lContinua And Thisform.Tg_Textbox3.Value=0
			lContinua = .F.
			=fMensAceptar("La cantidad de bultos no puede quedar en 0.")
		Endif
		
		
		If lContinua And Thisform.Tg_TextBox7.Value > (Thisform.Tg_TextBox8.Value - Thisform.Tg_TextBox9.Value)
			lContinua = .F.
			=fMensAceptar("La cantidad de unidades no puede ser mayor a " + Str(Thisform.Tg_TextBox8.Value - Thisform.Tg_TextBox9.Value,15,5) + ".")
		Endif
		
		If lContinua And Thisform.Tg_TextBox7.Value < 0
			lContinua = .F.
			=fMensAceptar("La cantidad de unidades no puede menor a 1.")
			
		Endif}
		Return lContinua
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_btnAgregar.Click
		ThisForm.Height = 400	
		
		Thisform.Tg_btnGrabar.Enabled   = .T.
		Thisform.Tg_btnDeshacer.Enabled = .T.
		This.Enabled = .F.
		Thisform.AgregarPallet()
		
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_btnAnularLectura.Click
		Thisform.AnularLectura()
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_btnAnularPallet.Click
		Thisform.Height = 506
		
		ThisForm.Tg_btnGrabarAnulacion.Enabled = .T.
		Thisform.oEdtObservaciones.Enabled = .T.
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_btncancelar2.Click
		ThisForm.Height = 400	
		tg_btnCancelar::Click
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_btnDeshacer.Click
		Local lAlta
		
		lAlta = .F.
		
		Thisform.InicializarComponentes(lAlta)
		This.Enabled = .F.
		Thisform.Tg_btnAgregar.Enabled = .T.
		Thisform.Tg_btnGrabar.Enabled  = .F.
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_btnGrabar.Click
		ThisForm.Height = 400	
		
		If Thisform.Validar()
			thisform.GrabarPallet()
			This.Enabled = .F.
			Thisform.Tg_btnAgregar.Enabled  = .T.
			Thisform.Tg_btnDeshacer.Enabled = .F.
		Endif
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_btnGrabarAnulacion.Click
		If Empty(ThisForm.oEdtObservaciones.Value)
			=fMensAceptar("Debe completar las observaciones de anulación!!!")
		Else
			Thisform.AnularPallet()
			ThisForm.Height = 400	
			ThisForm.Tg_btnGrabarAnulacion.Enabled = .F.
			Thisform.oEdtObservaciones.Enabled = .F.
		Endif
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_textbox7.LostFocus
		If This.Value<>0
			 Thisform.Tg_Textbox3.Value = Round(This.Value / Thisform.Coef_Uni_Med2,2)
		Endif
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_textbox7.Valid
		If This.Value<>0
			 Thisform.Tg_Textbox3.Value = Round(This.Value / Thisform.Coef_Uni_Med2,2)
		Endif
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_textbox7.When
		If This.Value<>0
			 Thisform.Tg_Textbox3.Value = Round(This.Value / Thisform.Coef_Uni_Med2,2)
		Endif
		
		
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

	PROCEDURE configurarcolumnas
		Local nColumnas, nMesUltimo, nAnioUltimo, nCantMeses, nPrimerDia, nMesProximo, nAnioProximo, nPrimerDiaProximo
		Local nUltimoDiaUltimo, nUltimoDia, nPrimerDiaPeriodo, cNomMes, dFechaActual
		Local vGrabacion, i , m
		Local dFechaAtrasoDesde1, dFechaAtrasoHasta1
		Local dFechaAtrasoDesde2, dFechaAtrasoHasta2
		Local dFechaAtrasoDesde3, dFechaAtrasoHasta3
		Local dFechaAtrasoDesde4, dFechaAtrasoHasta4
		Local dFechaDesde1, dFechaHasta1
		Local dFechaDesde2, dFechaHasta2
		Local dFechaDesde3, dFechaHasta3
		Local dFechaDesde4, dFechaHasta4
		Local dFechaDesde5, dFechaHasta5
		Local dFechaDesde6, dFechaHasta6
		Local dFechaDesde7, dFechaHasta7
		Local dFechaDesde8, dFechaHasta8
		Local dFechaDesde9, dFechaHasta9
		
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		Thisform.oCaj_CashFlow.revertir()
		
		nColumnas = 21
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.ColumnCount = 3
		thisform.tg_grid1.ColumnCount = nColumnas
		thisform.tg_grid1.ScrollBars = 3
		
		dFechaActual = oApp.CargarFechaSistema()
		
		dFechaAtrasoHasta1 = dFechaActual - 1
		dFechaAtrasoDesde1 = dFechaActual - Thisform.Tg_TextBox1.Value
		
		dFechaAtrasoHasta2 = dFechaActual - Thisform.Tg_TextBox1.Value - 1
		dFechaAtrasoDesde2 = dFechaActual - Thisform.Tg_TextBox2.Value
		
		dFechaAtrasoHasta3 = dFechaActual - Thisform.Tg_TextBox2.Value - 1
		dFechaAtrasoDesde3 = dFechaActual - Thisform.Tg_TextBox3.Value
		
		dFechaAtrasoHasta4 = dFechaActual - Thisform.Tg_TextBox3.Value - 1
		dFechaAtrasoDesde4 = ctod("01/01/1990")
		
		dFechaDesde1 = dFechaActual
		dFechaHasta1 = dFechaActual + Thisform.Tg_TextBox4.Value - 1
		
		dFechaDesde2 = dFechaHasta1 + 1
		dFechaHasta2 = dFechaDesde2 + Thisform.Tg_TextBox4.Value - 1 
		
		dFechaDesde3 = dFechaHasta2 + 1
		dFechaHasta3 = dFechaDesde3 + Thisform.Tg_TextBox4.Value - 1 
		
		dFechaDesde4 = dFechaHasta3 + 1
		dFechaHasta4 = dFechaDesde4 + Thisform.Tg_TextBox4.Value - 1 
		
		dFechaDesde5 = dFechaHasta4 + 1
		nMesUltimo = month(dFechaDesde5)
		nAnioUltimo = year(dFechaDesde5)
		nMesProximo = iif(nMesUltimo = 12, 1, nMesUltimo + 1)
		nAnioProximo = iif(nMesUltimo <> 12, nAnioUltimo, nAnioUltimo + 1)
		nPrimerDiaProximo = ctod("01/"+padl(alltrim(str(nMesProximo,2)),2,"0")+"/"+str(nAnioProximo,4))
		dFechaHasta5 = nPrimerDiaProximo  - 1
		
		dFechaDesde6 = nPrimerDiaProximo
		nMesUltimo = month(dFechaDesde6)
		nAnioUltimo = year(dFechaDesde6)
		nMesProximo = iif(nMesUltimo = 12, 1, nMesUltimo + 1)
		nAnioProximo = iif(nMesUltimo <> 12, nAnioUltimo, nAnioUltimo + 1)
		nPrimerDiaProximo = ctod("01/"+padl(alltrim(str(nMesProximo,2)),2,"0")+"/"+str(nAnioProximo,4))
		dFechaHasta6 = nPrimerDiaProximo - 1
		
		dFechaDesde7 = nPrimerDiaProximo
		nMesUltimo = month(dFechaDesde7)
		nAnioUltimo = year(dFechaDesde7)
		nMesProximo = iif(nMesUltimo = 12, 1, nMesUltimo + 1)
		nAnioProximo = iif(nMesUltimo <> 12, nAnioUltimo, nAnioUltimo + 1)
		nPrimerDiaProximo = ctod("01/"+padl(alltrim(str(nMesProximo,2)),2,"0")+"/"+str(nAnioProximo,4))
		dFechaHasta7 = nPrimerDiaProximo - 1
		
		dFechaDesde8 = nPrimerDiaProximo
		nMesUltimo = month(dFechaDesde8)
		nAnioUltimo = year(dFechaDesde8)
		nMesProximo = iif(nMesUltimo = 12, 1, nMesUltimo + 1)
		nAnioProximo = iif(nMesUltimo <> 12, nAnioUltimo, nAnioUltimo + 1)
		nPrimerDiaProximo = ctod("01/"+padl(alltrim(str(nMesProximo,2)),2,"0")+"/"+str(nAnioProximo,4))
		dFechaHasta8 = nPrimerDiaProximo - 1
		
		dFechaDesde9 = nPrimerDiaProximo
		dFechaHasta9 = ctod("31/12/2089")
		
		* Columna cobro adelantado recibos no imputados
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(4).FontSize = 8
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(4).Inputmask = "999999999.99"
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(4).Header1.Caption = "Adelantos"
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(4).Header1.Alignment = 2
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(4).Header1.BackColor = rgb(128,128,128)
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(4).Header1.ForeColor = rgb(255,255,255)
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(4).Header1.FontSize = 8

	PROCEDURE darmesabreviado
		lParameters nMes
		
		Do Case 
		
		   Case nMes = 1
		        return("Ene")
		   Case nMes = 2
		        return("Feb")
		   Case nMes = 3
		        return("Mar")
		   Case nMes = 4
		        return("Abr")
		   Case nMes = 5
		        return("May")
		   Case nMes = 6
		        return("Jun")
		   Case nMes = 7
		        return("Jul")
		   Case nMes = 8
		        return("Ago")
		   Case nMes = 9
		        return("Set")
		   Case nMes = 10
		        return("Oct")
		   Case nMes = 11
		        return("Nov")
		   Case nMes = 12
		        return("Dic")
		
		EndCase
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE ejecutarconsulta
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		dodefault()
		thisform.SetearHelpConTextId("Consulta")
		
		thisform.AddObject("oViewVencimientosCliente","Tg_ViewVencimientosProveedor")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblClientes","tg_tabla","Proveedores","clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oVnt_Docu","tg_tabla","Cmp_Docu","clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblMonedas","tg_tabla","Monedas","clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblParametros","tg_tabla","Parametros")
		thisform.AddObject("oCaj_Cashflow","tg_tabla","Caj_CashFlow","clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oCategorias","tg_tabla","CatProveedores","clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oAux_EstadisticasEvolucion","tg_tabla","Aux_EstadisticasEvolucion")
		
		Thisform.oCaj_Cashflow.SetearProp("BOT")
		Thisform.oAux_EstadisticasEvolucion.SetearProp("BOT")
		
		Thisform.Tg_TextBox1.Value = 30
		Thisform.Tg_TextBox2.Value = 60
		Thisform.Tg_TextBox3.Value = 90
		Thisform.Tg_TextBox4.Value = 7
		
		Thisform.ConfigurarColumnas()
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		
		thisform.Id_ArticuloDesde=Space(15)
		thisform.Id_ArticuloHasta=space(15)
		thisform.Id_Marca=Space(3)
		thisform.Id_Rubro=Space(3)
		thisform.Id_SubRubro=Space(3)
		
		thisform.tg_PresentaMoneda1.AsignarMonedaDefault(thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("Mon_Def"))
		thisform.tg_cmbSucursales1.SetearTodos()
		thisform.tg_cmbCatProveedores1.SetearTodos()
		thisform.tg_cmbSucursales1.Value="TD"
		thisform.tg_cmbCatProveedores1.Value="TD"
		
		thisform.OldId_moneda=thisform.Tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarMoneda()
		thisform.OldId_Sucursal=thisform.Tg_CmbSucursales1.Value
		thisform.OldId_Vendedor=thisform.Tg_CmbCatProveedores1.Value
		thisform.OldTipoCotizacion=thisform.Tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarTipoCotizacion()
		*thisform.OldFormato=thisform.oOpgTipoComprobante.Value
		*thisform.tg_grid1.ResaltarRenglon
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarcomprobante
		IF ThisForm.oOpgTipoComprobante.Value=2
			If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante")<>T_OBJECT			 
				thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante","TG_ConsultaComprobante",thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)				
				thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.Show()
			Else
				Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.ConsultarComprobante(thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)			
			Endif	
		Endif	
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescaraplicacion
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarconsulta
		Local dFechaDesde, dFechaHasta, nColumna, vGrabacion, mCampo, cId_Articulo, nCantidad, nImporte, cDetalle, nTotal
		Local nacumula, cId_cliente, nSaldo, nSaldoTotal, nSaldoVencido
		Local nCreditos, nCobranzas, nSaldosaVencer, cId_Comprobante, lSumar
		Local nDiasCorrimiento, vCuadroVendedores, cId_Vendedor, i, mmpp
		Local cId_Categoria
		
		Thisform.ConfigurarColumnas()
		
		Thisform.oAux_EstadisticasEvolucion.Revertir()
		
		if Thisform.Tg_OptionGroup1.Value = 1
		   Thisform.oTblClientes.FijarTag("Clave")
		endif
		if Thisform.Tg_OptionGroup1.Value = 2
		   Thisform.oTblClientes.FijarTag("Nombre")
		endif
		
		*Thisform.oAux_EstadisticasEvolucion.FijarTag("Codigo")
		
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		thisform.SetearCursorEspera
		thisform.LockScreen=.t.	
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		
		Thisform.oTblClientes.IrPrimero()
		
		Do while !Thisform.oTblClientes.EsEof()
		
		   cId_Cliente = Thisform.oTblClientes.Leer("Id_Proveedor")
		   nDiasCorrimiento = Thisform.oTblClientes.Leer("DiasVencCash")
		   cId_Categoria = Thisform.oTblClientes.Leer("Id_Categoria")
		   
		   Thisform.oCategorias.Buscar(cId_Categoria,.f.,"Clave") 
		   * si el vendedor esta en el rango
		   
		   if Thisform.Tg_CmbCatProveedores1.Value = "TD" or Thisform.Tg_CmbCatProveedores1.Value = Thisform.oTblClientes.Leer("Id_Categoria")
		   
		      thisform.oViewVencimientosCliente.Refrescar(cId_Cliente)
		   
		      * si tiene deuda
		        
		      if !thisform.oViewVencimientosCliente.EsTablaVacia()
		      
		         =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Codigo"    , cId_Cliente )      
		         =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Nombre"    , Thisform.oTblClientes.Leer("Razon_Social"))
		         =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Categoria" , Thisform.oCategorias.Leer("Nombre"))
		         Thisform.oAux_EstadisticasEvolucion.AgregarYModificar(@vGrabacion,.t.)
		       
		         thisform.oCaj_CashFlow.IrPrimero()
		
		         nColumna = 0 && lo tomo como numero de registro
		
		         nSaldoTotal = 0
		         nSaldoaVencer = 0
		         nCreditos = 0
		         nCobranzas = 0
		         nSaldoVencido = 0
		         
		         Do while !thisform.oCaj_CashFlow.EsEof()
		
		            dFechaDesde =  thisform.oCaj_CashFlow.Leer("FechaDesde")
		            dFechaHasta =  thisform.oCaj_CashFlow.Leer("FechaHasta")
		   
		            if nColumna = 4
		               nColumna = 5
		            endif
		               
		            nColumna = nColumna + 1
		   
		            mCampo = "Campo"+alltrim(str(nColumna+2))
		      
		            thisform.oViewVencimientosCliente.IrPrimero()
		   
		            nSaldo = 0  
		         
		            do while !thisform.oViewVencimientosCliente.EsEof()
		
		               if (thisform.oViewVencimientosCliente.Leer("Fecha_Venc") + nDiasCorrimiento) >= dFechaDesde and (thisform.oViewVencimientosCliente.Leer("Fecha_Venc") + nDiasCorrimiento) <= dFechaHasta
		                  Thisform.oVnt_Docu.Buscar(thisform.oViewVencimientosCliente.Leer("Id_Comproba"),.f.,"Clave")
		                  * aca proceso solo comprobantes del debe sin notas de credito ni cobranzas
		                  if Thisform.oVnt_Docu.Leer("Suma") and !Thisform.oVnt_Docu.Leer("Pago") 
		                     nSaldo = nSaldo +  thisform.oViewVencimientosCliente.Leer("Saldo")
		                  endif   
		                  *if !Thisform.oVnt_Docu.Leer("Suma") and !Thisform.oVnt_Docu.Leer("Pago") 
		                  *   cId_Comprobante = thisform.oViewVencimientosCliente.Leer("Id_Comproba")
		                  *   Thisform.oVnt_Docu.IrPrimero()
		                  *   do while !Thisform.oVnt_Docu.EsEof()
		                  *      if Thisform.oVnt_Docu.Leer("Id_ComAcreditacion")=cId_Comprobante
		                  *         nSaldo = nSaldo - thisform.oViewVencimientosCliente.Leer("Saldo")
		                  *         exit
		                  *      endif   
		                  *      Thisform.oVnt_Docu.IrSiguiente()
		                  *   enddo
		                  *endif
		               endif
		                 
		               thisform.oViewVencimientosCliente.IrSiguiente()
		      
		            enddo 
		            
		            =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, mCampo    , nSaldo )
		            Thisform.oAux_EstadisticasEvolucion.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)
		   
		            thisform.oCaj_CashFlow.IrSiguiente()
		    
		         enddo
		         
		         * proceso cobranzas y creditos
		                   
		         thisform.oViewVencimientosCliente.IrPrimero()
		         
		         do while !thisform.oViewVencimientosCliente.EsEof()
		
		            Thisform.oVnt_Docu.Buscar(thisform.oViewVencimientosCliente.Leer("Id_Comproba"),.f.,"Clave")
		            
		            if !Thisform.oVnt_Docu.Leer("Suma") and !Thisform.oVnt_Docu.Leer("Pago") 
		                  nCreditos = nCreditos + thisform.oViewVencimientosCliente.Leer("Saldo")
		            endif   
		            if !Thisform.oVnt_Docu.Leer("Suma") and Thisform.oVnt_Docu.Leer("Pago") 
		               nCobranzas = nCobranzas + thisform.oViewVencimientosCliente.Leer("Saldo")
		            endif
		               
		            thisform.oViewVencimientosCliente.IrSiguiente()
		      
		         enddo 
		         
		         =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "CAMPO1" , nCobranzas * (-1) )
		         =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "CAMPO2" , nCreditos * (-1) )
		         Thisform.oAux_EstadisticasEvolucion.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)
		         
		         * proceso deuda vencida columna 7 sumatoria de columnas de 3 a 6 y de paso acumulo total
		         for i = 3 to 6
		             mCampo = "Campo"+alltrim(str(i))
		             nSaldoVencido = nSaldoVencido + Thisform.oAux_EstadisticasEvolucion.Leer(mCampo)
		             nSaldoTotal   = nSaldoTotal   + Thisform.oAux_EstadisticasEvolucion.Leer(mCampo)
		         next
		         =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "CAMPO7" , nSaldoVencido )
		         Thisform.oAux_EstadisticasEvolucion.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)
		       
		         * proceso deuda a vencer columna 20 sumatoria de columnas de 8 a 16 de paso acumulo total    
		         for i = 8 to 16
		             mCampo = "Campo"+alltrim(str(i))
		             nSaldoaVencer = nSaldoaVencer + Thisform.oAux_EstadisticasEvolucion.Leer(mCampo)
		             nSaldoTotal   = nSaldoTotal   + Thisform.oAux_EstadisticasEvolucion.Leer(mCampo)
		         next
		         =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "CAMPO17" , nSaldoaVencer )
		         Thisform.oAux_EstadisticasEvolucion.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)
		         
		         * proceso campo total
		         =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Total" , nSaldoaVencer+nSaldoVencido-nCreditos-nCobranzas )
		         Thisform.oAux_EstadisticasEvolucion.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)
		         
		      endif
		      
		   endif   
		   
		   Thisform.oTblClientes.IrSiguiente()
		   
		enddo   
		
		Thisform.oAux_EstadisticasEvolucion.IrPrimero()
		
		thisform.RefrescarGrilla
		
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.f.
		ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
