	PROCEDURE Tg_grid2.Column12.Text1.Valid
		Local nCant_Pendiente, nRegistro, cId_ComBas, nNro_ReferenciaBase, dFecha_Entrega, cId_Proveedor, nRenglon, nCant_Necesaria, lvalida
		Local vGrabacion, cConfirma, cRazon_Social , cId_articulo, cNombre, dFec_Ent_Real
		
		Dimension vGRabacion[1,2]
		if this.value < 0 
		
		   return(.f.)
		endif
		
		if empty(Thisform.oTblAux_CotizaRequerimientos.Leer("Razon_Social"))
		   return(.t.)
		endif
		
		if Thisform.oTblAux_CotizaRequerimientos.Leer("Id_Proveedor")=space(5)
		   if this.value = 0
		      return(.t.)
		   else   
		      =fMensAceptar("Debe dar de alta al Proveedor para efectuar una compra !!!")   
		      
		      if !Thisform.oTblAux_CotizaRequerimientos.Leer("AltaRegistrada")
		      
		         cConfirma=fMensPregunto(" Desea Registrar un Pedido de alta del Proveedor ? ","N",.t.)
		      
		         if cConfirma = "S"
		         
		            nRegistro = Thisform.oTblAux_CotizaRequerimientos.Recno()        
		            
		            cRazon_Social       = Thisform.oTblAux_CotizaRequerimientos.Leer("Razon_Social")
		         
		            Thisform.oTblAux_CotizaRequerimientos.IrPrimero()
		            
		            Do while !Thisform.oTblAux_CotizaRequerimientos.EsEof()
		            
		               if  Thisform.oTblAux_CotizaRequerimientos.Leer("Razon_Social") = cRazon_Social
		               
		                   cId_Comproba        = Thisform.oTblAux_CotizaRequerimientos.Leer("Id_Comproba")          
		                   nNro_Referencia     = Thisform.oTblAux_CotizaRequerimientos.Leer("Nro_Referencia")
		                   cId_Proveedor       = space(5)
		                   cId_Articulo        = Thisform.oTblAux_CotizaRequerimientos.Leer("Id_Articulo") 
		                   cNombre             = Thisform.oTblAux_CotizaRequerimientos.Leer("Nombre") 
		                   cId_ComBas          = Thisform.oTblAux_CotizaRequerimientos.Leer("Id_ComBas")
		                   nNro_ReferenciaBase = Thisform.oTblAux_CotizaRequerimientos.Leer("Nro_ReferenciaBase")
		                   nRenglonBase        = Thisform.oTblAux_CotizaRequerimientos.Leer("RenglonBase")
		                   dFec_Ent_Real       = Thisform.oTblAux_CotizaRequerimientos.Leer("Fec_Ent_Real")
		                   nCant_Necesaria     = Thisform.oTblAux_CotizaRequerimientos.Leer("Cant_Necesaria")
		               
		                   =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Id_Comproba"         , cId_Comproba)      
		                   =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Nro_Referencia"      , nNro_Referencia)                         
		                   =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Id_Proveedor"        , cId_Proveedor)
		                   =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Razon_Social"        , cRazon_Social)
		                   =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Id_Articulo"         , cId_Articulo)
		                   =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Nombre"              , Nombre)
		                   =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Fec_Ent_Real"        , dFec_Ent_Real)
		                   =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Cant_Necesaria"      , nCant_Necesaria)
		                   =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Id_ComBas"           , cId_ComBas)
		                   =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Nro_ReferenciaBas"   , nNro_ReferenciaBase)                         
		                   =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "RenglonBase"         , nRenglonBase)
		                   Thisform.oCmp_PedidosAltasProveedores.AgregarYModificar(@vGRabacion,.t.)                    
		                   
		                   =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "AltaRegistrada"      , .t.)      
		                   Thisform.oTblAux_CotizaRequerimientos.Modificar(@vGRabacion,.f.,.t.)
		                   
		               endif
		              
		               Thisform.oTblAux_CotizaRequerimientos.IrSiguiente()
		               
		            enddo    
		         
		         endif
		         
		      else
		      
		         =fMensAceptar("Ya tiene Registrado el Pedido de Alta !!!")   
		         
		      endif      
		      return(.f.)
		   endif   
		endif
		
		nCant_Pendiente = Thisform.oTblAux_CotizaRequerimientos.Leer("Cant_Pendiente")
		
		*if This.Value > nCant_Pendiente
		*   return(.f.)
		*endif   
		
		if This.Value >= 0 &&nCant_Pendiente 
		   nRegistro           = Thisform.oTblAux_CotizaRequerimientos.Recno()
		   cId_ComBas          = Thisform.oTblAux_CotizaRequerimientos.Leer("Id_ComBas")
		   nNro_ReferenciaBase = Thisform.oTblAux_CotizaRequerimientos.Leer("Nro_ReferenciaBase")
		   dFecha_Entrega      = Thisform.oTblAux_CotizaRequerimientos.Leer("Fecha_Entrega")
		   cId_Proveedor       = Thisform.oTblAux_CotizaRequerimientos.Leer("Id_Proveedor")
		   nRenglon            = Thisform.oTblAux_CotizaRequerimientos.Leer("Reng_Cotizacion")
		   nCant_Necesaria     = Thisform.oTblAux_CotizaRequerimientos.Leer("Cant_Necesaria")
		   
		   lValida = Thisform.RecalcularProveedor(cId_ComBas, nNro_ReferenciaBase, dFecha_Entrega, This.Value, cId_Proveedor, nRenglon, nCant_Necesaria)
		   Thisform.oTblAux_CotizaRequerimientos.IrRegistro(nRegistro)
		   
		   if lValida 
		      if This.Value <> 0  
		         =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Seleccionado",.t.)      
		      else
		         =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Seleccionado",.f.)      
		      endif
		      Thisform.oTblAux_CotizaRequerimientos.Modificar(@vGRabacion,.f.,.t.)   
		   endif
		   return(lValida)      
		else
		   return(.f.)
		endif   
		
		
	ENDPROC

		Local nCant_Pendiente, nRegistro, cId_ComBas, nNro_ReferenciaBase, dFecha_Entrega, cId_Proveedor, nRenglon, nCant_Necesaria, lvalida

		      Enddo
		      
		   endif
		   
		   * aca tengo que poner a cero los proveedores secundarios si es que son los que se estan mostrando en otras cotizaciones
		   
		   if !Thisform.oTblAux_OtrasCotizaRequerimientos.EsTablaVacia()
		      Thisform.oTblAux_OtrasCotizaRequerimientos.IrPrimero()
		      Do while !Thisform.oTblAux_OtrasCotizaRequerimientos.EsEof()
		         cRegistro = Thisform.oTblAux_OtrasCotizaRequerimientos.Leer("Id_Comproba")+str(Thisform.oTblAux_OtrasCotizaRequerimientos.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),10)+;
		                     Thisform.oTblAux_OtrasCotizaRequerimientos.Leer("Id_ComBas")+str(Thisform.oTblAux_OtrasCotizaRequerimientos.Leer("Nro_ReferenciaBase"),10)+;
		                     str(Thisform.oTblAux_OtrasCotizaRequerimientos.Leer("RenglonBase"),10)
		         if cRegistro = cClave
		            =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Total"              ,0)         
		            =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Cant_Compra"        ,0)   
		            =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Seleccionado"       ,.f.)
		            Thisform.oTblAux_OtrasCotizaRequerimientos.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)
		         endif            
		         Thisform.oTblAux_OtrasCotizaRequerimientos.IrSiguiente()
		      enddo
		   endif
		   
		   return(.t.)
		   
		endif   
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid2.Column14.Tg_commandbutton2.Click
		thisform.MostrarOtrasCotizaciones()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid2.Column3.Text1.Valid
		Local vGrabacion, nTotal, nPunitario, nRegistro, cId_Proveedor
		
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		if empty(Thisform.oTblAux_CotizaRequerimientos.Leer("Razon_Social"))
		   return(.t.)
		endif
		
		*if this.value = 0
		*   return(.f.)
		*else
		   nPunitario = Thisform.oTblAux_CotizaRequerimientos.Leer("Precio")
		   nTotal = Round(This.value * nPunitario,2)
		   cId_Proveedor = Thisform.oTblAux_CotizaRequerimientos.Leer("Id_Proveedor")
		   
		   =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Total",nTotal)
		      
		   Thisform.oTblAux_CotizaRequerimientos.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)
		   
		   *nRegistro = Thisform.oTblAux_CotizaRequerimientos.recno()
		   
		   Thisform.RecalcularProveedor(cId_Proveedor)
		   
		   *Thisform.oTblAux_CotizaRequerimientos.IrRegistro(nRegistro)
		   
		   return(.t.)
		*endif      
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid2.Column4.Text1.DblClick
		thisform.MostrarComprobante
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid2.Column4.Text1.Valid
		Local vGrabacion, nTotal, nCantidad, nRegistro, cId_Proveedor
		
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		if empty(Thisform.oTblAux_CotizaRequerimientos.Leer("Razon_Social"))
		   return(.t.)
		endif
		
		*if this.value = 0
		*   return(.f.)
		*else
		   nCantidad = Thisform.oTblAux_CotizaRequerimientos.Leer("Cantidad")
		   nTotal = Round(This.value * nCantidad,2)
		   cId_Proveedor = Thisform.oTblAux_CotizaRequerimientos.Leer("Id_Proveedor")
		   
		   =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Total",nTotal)
		      
		   Thisform.oTblAux_CotizaRequerimientos.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)
		   
		   *nRegistro = Thisform.oTblAux_CotizaRequerimientos.recno()
		   
		*   Thisform.RecalcularProveedor(cId_Proveedor)
		   
		   *Thisform.oTblAux_CotizaRequerimientos.IrRegistro(nRegistro)
		   
		   return(.t.)
		*endif      
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid2.Column6.Text1.DblClick
		thisform.MostrarComprobante
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid2.Column6.Text1.Valid
		Local vGrabacion, dFecha_entrega, nDiasCorrimiento
		
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		if Thisform.oTblAux_CotizaRequerimientos.Leer("Razon_Social") = space(30)
		   return(.t.)
		endif
		
		if this.value <= oApp.CargarFechaSistema() 
		   return(.f.)
		else
		   dFecha_Entrega = Thisform.oTblAux_CotizaRequerimientos.Leer("Fecha_entrega")
		   nDiasCorrimiento = This.value - dFecha_entrega
		   
		   =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"diasCorrimiento",nDiasCorrimiento)
		      
		   Thisform.oTblAux_CotizaRequerimientos.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)
		   
		   return(.t.)
		endif      
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid2.dblclickencelda
		Thisform.MostrarComprobante
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

	PROCEDURE Init
		**** David **********
		lParameters cId_Articulo,vCmp_DocuSel,dFechaVtoMaximo
		**** David **********
		
		dodefault()
		thisform.SetearHelpConTextId("ConsultaCompras")
		thisform.AddObject("oViewArtADescargar","Tg_ViewArtADescargarCompras")
		thisform.AddObject("oViewArtADescargarDetallado","Tg_ViewArtADescargarDetalladoCompras")
		
		thisform.AddObject("oTblProveedores","tg_tabla","Proveedores","clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblMonedas","tg_tabla","Monedas","clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblParametros","tg_tabla","Parametros")
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewArtADescargar.Alias
		
		thisform.Id_ArticuloDesde=Space(15)
		thisform.Id_ArticuloHasta=space(15)
		thisform.Id_Marca=Space(3)
		thisform.Id_Rubro=Space(3)
		thisform.Id_SubRubro=Space(3)
		
		thisform.tg_PresentaMoneda1.AsignarMonedaDefault(thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("Mon_Def"))
		thisform.tg_cmbSucursales1.SetearTodos()
		thisform.tg_cmbSucursales1.Value="TD"
		
		Thisform.oTbxFechaDesde.Value=cTod("  /  /  ")
		Thisform.oTbxFechaHasta.Value=cTod("  /  /  ")
		******** david ********
		Thisform.oTbxFecVtoDesde.Value=cTod("  /  /  ")
		Thisform.oTbxFecVtoHasta.Value=cTod("  /  /  ")
		
		thisform.OldFecVtoDesde=Thisform.oTbxFecVtoDesde.Value
		thisform.OldFecVtoHasta=Thisform.oTbxFecVtoHasta.Value
		******** david ********
		thisform.OldFechaDesde=Thisform.oTbxFechaDesde.Value
		thisform.OldFechaHasta=Thisform.oTbxFechaHasta.Value
		thisform.OldId_moneda=thisform.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarMoneda()
		thisform.OldId_Sucursal=thisform.Tg_CmbSucursales1.Value
		thisform.OldTipoCotizacion=thisform.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarTipoCotizacion()
		thisform.OldFormato=ThisForm.oOpgTipoComprobante.Value
		
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.ResaltarRenglon
		
		******* david ********
		if type("cId_Articulo")<> "L"
		   thisform.Ocultar= .t.
		   thisform.RefrescarConsulta(cId_Articulo,@vCmp_DocuSel,dFechaVtoMaximo)
		else
		  thisform.Ocultar= .f.
		endif
		******* david *********
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarcomprobante
		IF ThisForm.oOpgTipoComprobante.Value=2
			If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante")<>T_OBJECT			 
				thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante","TG_ConsCompCompras",thisform.oViewArtADescargarDetallado.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewArtADescargarDetallado.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewArtADescargarDetallado.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewArtADescargarDetallado.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)				
				thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.Show()
			Else
				Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.ConsultarComprobante(thisform.oViewArtADescargarDetallado.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewArtADescargarDetallado.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewArtADescargarDetallado.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewArtADescargarDetallado.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)			
			Endif	
		Endif	
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE QueryUnload
		***** david *****
		Local lRetorna
		
		lRetorna=dodefault()
		If thisform.ReleaseType=1
			Nodefault	
			lRetorna=.f.
		    if thisform.Ocultar
		       thisform.Hide
		    else
		       thisform.Release
		    endif      
		Endif
		
		Return lRetorna
		****** david *******
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescaraplicacion
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarconsulta
		**** David **********
		lParameters cId_Articulo,vCmp_DocuSel,dFechaVtoMaximo
		
		******* david ********
		
		thisform.SetearCursorEspera
		thisform.LockScreen=.t.	
		
		if type("cId_Articulo")<> "L"
		   thisform.oOpgTipoComprobante.value= 2
		   Thisform.oTbxFecVtoHasta.Value= dFechaVtoMaximo
		   thisform.Id_ArticuloDesde= cId_Articulo
		   thisform.Id_ArticuloHasta= cId_Articulo
		   thisform.ID_Marca=    "TD"
		   thisform.ID_Rubro=    "TD"
		   thisform.ID_Subrubro= "TD"
		   =aCopy(vCmp_DocuSel,vComprobantes)
		   =aCopy(vCmp_DocuSel,thisform.Tg_seleccionarcomprobantesCompras1.vItems )
		
		   *@0403/4@	
		   For i=1 to alen(thisform.Tg_seleccionarcomprobantesCompras1.vItems, 1)
		  		thisform.Tg_seleccionarcomprobantesCompras1.vItems[i,2] = .f.
		   Endfor
		   For mmpp=1 to thisform.Tg_seleccionarcomprobantesCompras1.tg_ListBox1.ListCount
			    thisform.Tg_seleccionarcomprobantesCompras1.tg_listbox1.Picture(mmpp)=thisform.Tg_seleccionarcomprobantesCompras1.PictureDesMarcado	
		   endfor
		   For mmpp=1 to thisform.Tg_seleccionarcomprobantesCompras1.tg_ListBox1.ListCount
			   For i=1 to alen(vCmp_DocuSel,1)
				   if thisform.Tg_seleccionarcomprobantesCompras1.Tg_ListBox1.ListItem(mmpp,2) = vCmp_DocuSel[i,1]
				 		If vCmp_DocuSel[i,2]  
					  		thisform.Tg_seleccionarcomprobantesCompras1.tg_listbox1.Picture(mmpp)=thisform.Tg_seleccionarcomprobantesCompras1.PictureMarcado
					  		thisform.Tg_seleccionarcomprobantesCompras1.vItems[i,2] = .t.
					  	Endif
				   endif		                       
			   Endfor
		   Endfor
			*@0403/4@
		else
		   =aCopy(ThisForm.Tg_seleccionarcomprobantesCompras1.vItems,vComprobantes)
		endif
		******* david ********
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		IF ThisForm.oOpgTipoComprobante.Value=1
		*** david ****
			thisform.oViewArtADescargar.Refrescar(@vComprobantes,"",thisform.Tg_CmbSucursales1.Value,thisform.oTbxFechaDesde.Value,thisform.oTbxFechaHasta.Value,thisform.Id_articuloDesde,thisform.Id_ArticuloHasta,thisform.Id_Marca,thisform.Id_Rubro,thisform.ID_Subrubro,ThisForm.Tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarMoneda(),ThisForm.Tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarTipoCotizacion(),thisform.oTbxFecVtoDesde.Value,thisform.oTbxFecVtoHasta.Value )
		*** david 	
			thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewArtADescargar.Alias
		Else
		*** david ****
			thisform.oViewArtADescargarDetallado.Refrescar(@vComprobantes,"",thisform.Tg_CmbSucursales1.Value,thisform.oTbxFechaDesde.Value,thisform.oTbxFechaHasta.Value,thisform.Id_articuloDesde,thisform.Id_ArticuloHasta,thisform.Id_Marca,thisform.Id_Rubro,thisform.ID_Subrubro,ThisForm.Tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarMoneda(),ThisForm.Tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarTipoCotizacion(),thisform.oTbxFecVtoDesde.Value,thisform.oTbxFecVtoHasta.Value)
		*** david ****	
			thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewArtADescargarDetallado.Alias
		Endif	
		
		thisform.RefrescarGrilla
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.f.
		ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
		
		thisform.LockScreen=.f.	
		thisform.DesSetearCursorEspera
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla
		
		
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		
		IF ThisForm.oOpgTipoComprobante.Value=1
		
			thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewArtADescargar.Alias
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArtADescargar.Alias+".Id_Articulo"
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArtADescargar.Alias+".Detalle"
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArtADescargar.Alias+".Cantidad"
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column4.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArtADescargar.Alias+".Cant_Cancelada"
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column5.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArtADescargar.Alias+".Cant_Pendiente"
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column6.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArtADescargar.Alias+".SaldoStock"
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column7.Header1.Caption="Saldo Stock"
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column7.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArtADescargar.Alias+".SaldoStock"+"+"+thisform.oViewArtADescargar.Alias+".Cant_Pendiente"
		
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column1.ColumnOrder=1
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column2.ColumnOrder=2

	PROCEDURE Tg_commandbutton2.Click
		If Type("thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos")<>T_OBJECT			 
			thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos","TG_FrmFiltroArticulos")				
		Endif	
		thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.Show()
		
		IF  thisform.Id_articuloDesde<>thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.Id_articuloDesde or ;
			thisform.Id_articuloHasta<>thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.Id_articuloHasta  or;	
			thisform.id_Marca<>thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.id_Marca  or;
			thisform.id_rubro<>thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.id_rubro  or;
			thisform.id_Subrubro<>thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.id_Subrubro  
		
		
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.t.
			ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled		
		Endif	
		
		
		thisform.Id_articuloDesde=thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.Id_articuloDesde
		thisform.Id_articuloHasta=thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.Id_articuloHasta
		thisform.id_Marca=thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.id_Marca
		thisform.id_rubro=thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.id_rubro
		thisform.id_Subrubro=thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.id_Subrubro
		
		
	ENDPROC

		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			If this.ConsultarMoneda()<>thisform.OldId_Moneda .or. this.ConsultarTipoCotizacion()<>thisform.OldTipoCotizacion
				ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.t.
			Endif	
		Endif	
		thisform.OldId_Moneda=this.ConsultarMoneda()
		thisform.OldTipoCotizacion=this.ConsultarTipoCotizacion()
		ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE ejecutarconsulta
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		lParameters cId_Proveedor
		
		dodefault()
		thisform.SetearHelpConTextId("ConsultaCompras")
		thisform.AddObject("oViewArtADescargarProveedor","Tg_ViewArtADescargarProveedor")
		thisform.AddObject("oViewArtADescargarProveedorDetallado","Tg_ViewArtADescargarProveedorDetallado")
		
		thisform.AddObject("oTblProveedores","tg_tabla","Proveedores","clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblMonedas","tg_tabla","Monedas","clave")
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewArtADescargarProveedor.Alias
		thisform.tg_Proveedores1.Valida=TG_TC_VALIDAEXISTENCIA 
		ThisForm.Tg_seleccionarcomprobantesCompras1.DesHabilitar()
		
		
		If Type("cId_Proveedor")<>T_LOGICAL
			thisform.tg_Proveedores1.Value=cId_Proveedor
		*!*		thisform.tg_grid1.SetFocus()
			thisform.tg_Proveedores1.Valid
			thisform.tg_Proveedores1.Enabled=.f.
		Endif
		thisform.OldFormato=ThisForm.oOpgTipoComprobante.Value
		thisform.tg_grid1.ResaltarRenglon
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarcomprobante
		IF ThisForm.oOpgTipoComprobante.Value=2
			If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante")<>T_OBJECT			 
				thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante","TG_ConsCompCompras",thisform.oViewArtADescargarProveedorDetallado.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewArtADescargarProveedorDetallado.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewArtADescargarProveedorDetallado.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewArtADescargarProveedorDetallado.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)				
				thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.Show()
			Else
				Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.ConsultarComprobante(thisform.oViewArtADescargarProveedorDetallado.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewArtADescargarProveedorDetallado.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewArtADescargarProveedorDetallado.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewArtADescargarProveedorDetallado.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)			
			Endif	
		Endif	
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescaraplicacion
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarconsulta
		thisform.SetearCursorEspera
		thisform.LockScreen=.t.	
		
		=aCopy(ThisForm.Tg_seleccionarcomprobantesCompras1.vItems,vComprobantes)
		=aCopy(ThisForm.Tg_seleccionardeposito1.vItems,vDepositos)
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		IF ThisForm.oOpgTipoComprobante.Value=1
			thisform.oViewArtADescargarProveedor.Refrescar(thisForm.tg_Proveedores1.Value,@vComprobantes,@vDepositos)
			thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewArtADescargarProveedor.Alias
		Else
			thisform.oViewArtADescargarProveedorDetallado.Refrescar(thisForm.tg_Proveedores1.Value,@vComprobantes)
			thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewArtADescargarProveedorDetallado.Alias
		Endif	
		
		thisform.RefrescarGrilla
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.f.
		ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
		
		thisform.LockScreen=.f.	
		thisform.DesSetearCursorEspera
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla
		
		
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		
		IF ThisForm.oOpgTipoComprobante.Value=1
		
			thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewArtADescargarProveedor.Alias
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArtADescargarProveedor.Alias+".Id_Articulo"
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArtADescargarProveedor.Alias+".Detalle"
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArtADescargarProveedor.Alias+".Cantidad"
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column4.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArtADescargarProveedor.Alias+".Cant_Cancelada"
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column5.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArtADescargarProveedor.Alias+".Cant_Pendiente"
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column6.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArtADescargarProveedor.Alias+".SaldoStock"
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column7.Header1.Caption="Saldo Stock"
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column7.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArtADescargarProveedor.Alias+".SaldoStock"+"+"+thisform.oViewArtADescargarProveedor.Alias+".Cant_Pendiente"
		
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column1.ColumnOrder=1
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column2.ColumnOrder=2
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.ColumnOrder=3
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column4.ColumnOrder=4
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column5.ColumnOrder=5
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column6.ColumnOrder=6
			thisform.tg_Grid1.Column6.ResetToDefault("Width")
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column6.Resizable=.t.	
				
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column7.ColumnOrder=7
			
			
			thisform.tg_grid1.DoScroll(6)
			thisform.tg_grid1.DoScroll(6)
				
			thisform.tg_grid1.ScrollBars=2
		
			thisform.oTbxTotalPendiente.Value=0
		
		Else
			thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewArtADescargarProveedorDetallado.Alias
		
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArtADescargarProveedorDetallado.Alias+".Id_Articulo"
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArtADescargarProveedorDetallado.Alias+".Detalle"	
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArtADescargarProveedorDetallado.Alias+".Cantidad"
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column4.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArtADescargarProveedorDetallado.Alias+".Cant_Cancelada"
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column5.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArtADescargarProveedorDetallado.Alias+".Cant_Pendiente"
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column6.ControlSource=""
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column7.Header1.Caption="Imp. Pend."	
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column7.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArtADescargarProveedorDetallado.Alias+".Pendiente"	
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column8.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArtADescargarProveedorDetallado.Alias+".Id_Sucursal"
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column9.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArtADescargarProveedorDetallado.Alias+".ID_Comproba"
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column10.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArtADescargarProveedorDetallado.Alias+".Nro_Referencia"
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column11.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArtADescargarProveedorDetallado.Alias+".Nro_Externo"
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column12.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArtADescargarProveedorDetallado.Alias+".Fecha"

			thisform.tg_grid1.Column14.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArtADescargarProveedorDetallado.Alias+".Vencimiento"
		
			
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column1.ColumnOrder=1
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column2.ColumnOrder=10
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.ColumnOrder=7
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column4.ColumnOrder=9
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column5.ColumnOrder=8

			thisform.tg_grid1.Column6.Width=0
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column6.Resizable=.f.

			thisform.tg_grid1.Column8.ColumnOrder=2
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column9.ColumnOrder=3
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column10.ColumnOrder=4
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column11.ColumnOrder=5
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column12.ColumnOrder=6
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column13.ColumnOrder=12
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column14.ColumnOrder=13	
			
			thisform.tg_grid1.ScrollBars=3
		
			thisform.oTbxTotalPendiente.Value=Round(thisform.oViewArtADescargarProveedorDetallado.Sumar("Pendiente",".t."),2)
			
		Endif
		
		
		
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Refresh
		
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdDatosProveedor.Click
		Local oAbmGen
		
		oAbmGen=CreateObject("tg_FormConsulta","Proveedores",.f.,thisform.tg_Proveedores1.Value)
		oAbmGen.Show()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Click
		this.Parent.RefrescarConsulta
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oOpgTipoComprobante.InteractiveChange
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldFormato
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	
		Endif	
		thisform.OldFormato=this.Value
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.Column1.Text1.GotFocus
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.dblclickencelda
		thisform.MostrarComprobante
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_proveedores1.Valid
		local lValida
		lValida=tg_textclave::valid()
		thisform.ProveedorValidado=.f.
		if lValida.and.!this.FormDesactivado && .and.!thisform.ProveedorValidado
				
				thisform.oTblProveedores.Buscar(this.Value)
				ThisForm.RazonSocial.Value=thisform.oTblProveedores.Leer("Razon_Social")
				
				thisform.oTblMonedas.Buscar(thisform.oTblProveedores.Leer("Id_Moneda_Cta"))
				thisform.oTbxMoneda.Value=thisform.oTblMonedas.Leer("Nombre")
				thisform.ProveedorValidado=.t.
		endif
		If !this.FormDesactivado
			thisform.RefrescarConsulta
		Endif	
		
		If (thisform.ProveedorValidado.or.lValida).and.!this.FormDesactivado
			ThisForm.Tg_seleccionarcomprobantesCompras1.Habilitar()
			thisform.oCmdDatosProveedor.Enabled=.t.
		Else
			ThisForm.Tg_seleccionarcomprobantesCompras1.DesHabilitar()
			thisform.oCmdDatosProveedor.Enabled=.f.
			
		Endif	
		
		Return thisform.ProveedorValidado.or.lValida
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_seleccionarcomprobantescompras1.Init
		dodefault("List_Com_Pen=.t.",.t.)
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_seleccionarcomprobantescompras1.interactivechange
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled =this.ExistenMarcados()
		ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=.f.
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_seleccionardeposito1.Init
		dodefault(".t.",.t.)
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_seleccionardeposito1.interactivechange
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.ExistenMarcados()
		ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=.f.
		
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

	PROCEDURE Init
		lParameters cId_Proveedor
		
		dodefault()
		
		*thisform.SetearHelpConTextId("Consulta")
		thisform.AddObject("oViewArtCompradosProveedor","Tg_ViewArtCompradosProveedor")
		thisform.AddObject("oViewArtCompradosProveedorDetallado","Tg_ViewArtCompradosProveedorDetallado")
		
		thisform.AddObject("oTblProveedores","tg_tabla","Proveedores","clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblMonedas","tg_tabla","Monedas","clave")
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewArtCompradosProveedor.Alias
		ThisForm.Tg_seleccionarcomprobantesCompras1.DesHabilitar()
		
		thisform.Id_ArticuloDesde=Space(15)
		thisform.Id_ArticuloHasta=space(15)
		thisform.Id_Marca=Space(3)
		thisform.Id_Rubro=Space(3)
		thisform.Id_SubRubro=Space(3)
		
		
		ThisForm.oTbxFechaDesde.Value=Ctod("  /  /  ")
		ThisForm.oTbxFechaHasta.Value=Ctod("  /  /  ")
		
		thisform.OldFechaDesde=ThisForm.oTbxFechaDesde.Value
		thisform.OldFechaHasta=ThisForm.oTbxFechaHasta.Value
		
		If Type("cId_Proveedor")<> "L"
			thisform.tg_Proveedores1.Value=cId_Proveedor
			thisform.tg_Proveedores1.Valid
			thisform.tg_Proveedores1.Enabled=.f.
		Endif
		thisform.OldFormato=thisform.oOpgTipoComprobante.Value
		
		thisform.Tg_grid1.ResaltarRenglon
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarcomprobante
		IF ThisForm.oOpgTipoComprobante.Value=2
			If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante")<> "O"			 
				thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante","TG_ConsCompCompras",thisform.oViewArtCompradosProveedorDetallado.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewArtCompradosProveedorDetallado.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewArtCompradosProveedorDetallado.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewArtCompradosProveedorDetallado.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)				
				thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.Show()
			Else
				Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.ConsultarComprobante(thisform.oViewArtCompradosProveedorDetallado.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewArtCompradosProveedorDetallado.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewArtCompradosProveedorDetallado.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewArtCompradosProveedorDetallado.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)			
			Endif	
		Endif	
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescaraplicacion
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarconsulta
		thisform.SetearCursorEspera
		thisform.LockScreen=.t.	
		
		=aCopy(ThisForm.Tg_seleccionarcomprobantesCompras1.vItems,vComprobantes)
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		IF ThisForm.oOpgTipoComprobante.Value=1
			thisform.oViewArtCompradosProveedor.Refrescar(thisForm.tg_Proveedores1.Value,@vComprobantes,ThisForm.oTbxFechaDesde.Value,ThisForm.oTbxFechaHasta.Value,thisform.Id_articuloDesde,thisform.Id_ArticuloHasta,thisform.Id_Marca,thisform.Id_Rubro,thisform.ID_Subrubro)
			thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewArtCompradosProveedor.Alias
		Else
			thisform.oViewArtCompradosProveedorDetallado.Refrescar(thisForm.tg_Proveedores1.Value,@vComprobantes,ThisForm.oTbxFechaDesde.Value,ThisForm.oTbxFechaHasta.Value,thisform.Id_articuloDesde,thisform.Id_ArticuloHasta,thisform.Id_Marca,thisform.Id_Rubro,thisform.ID_Subrubro)
			thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewArtCompradosProveedorDetallado.Alias
		Endif	
		
		thisform.RefrescarGrilla
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.f.
		ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
		thisform.LockScreen=.f.	
		thisform.DesSetearCursorEspera
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		
		IF ThisForm.oOpgTipoComprobante.Value=1
		
			thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewArtCompradosProveedor.Alias
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArtCompradosProveedor.Alias+".Id_Articulo"
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArtCompradosProveedor.Alias+".Detalle"
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArtCompradosProveedor.Alias+".Cantidad"
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column4.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArtCompradosProveedor.Alias+".PrecioUni"
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column5.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArtCompradosProveedor.Alias+".Total"
		
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column1.ColumnOrder=1
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column2.ColumnOrder=2
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.ColumnOrder=3
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column4.ColumnOrder=4
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column5.ColumnOrder=5
			
			thisform.tg_grid1.DoScroll(6)
			thisform.tg_grid1.DoScroll(6)
			
		
			thisform.tg_grid1.ScrollBars=2
		
			thisform.oTbxTotalPendiente.Value=Round(thisform.oViewArtCompradosProveedor.Sumar("Total",".t."),2)
		
		Else
			thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewArtCompradosProveedorDetallado.Alias
		
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource= thisform.oViewArtCompradosProveedorDetallado.Alias+".Id_Articulo"
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource= thisform.oViewArtCompradosProveedorDetallado.Alias+".Detalle"	
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource= thisform.oViewArtCompradosProveedorDetallado.Alias+".Cantidad"
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column4.ControlSource= thisform.oViewArtCompradosProveedorDetallado.Alias+".PrecioUni"
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column5.ControlSource= thisform.oViewArtCompradosProveedorDetallado.Alias+".Total"
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column6.ControlSource= thisform.oViewArtCompradosProveedorDetallado.Alias+".Id_Sucursal"
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column7.ControlSource= thisform.oViewArtCompradosProveedorDetallado.Alias+".ID_Comproba"
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column8.ControlSource= thisform.oViewArtCompradosProveedorDetallado.Alias+".Nro_Referencia"
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column9.ControlSource= thisform.oViewArtCompradosProveedorDetallado.Alias+".Nro_Externo"
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column10.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArtCompradosProveedorDetallado.Alias+".Fecha"
			
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column1.ColumnOrder=1
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column2.ColumnOrder=10
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.ColumnOrder=7
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column4.ColumnOrder=8	
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column5.ColumnOrder=9
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column6.ColumnOrder=2
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column7.ColumnOrder=3
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column8.ColumnOrder=4
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column9.ColumnOrder=5
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column10.ColumnOrder=6
			
			thisform.oTbxTotalPendiente.Value=Round(thisform.oViewArtCompradosProveedorDetallado.Sumar("Total",".t."),2)
			thisform.tg_grid1.ScrollBars=3
		
		
		Endif
		
		
		
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Refresh
		
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdDatosCliente.Click
		Local oAbmGen
		
		oAbmGen=CreateObject("tg_FormConsulta","Proveedores",.f.,thisform.tg_Proveedores1.Value)
		oAbmGen.Show()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Click
		this.Parent.RefrescarConsulta
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdFiltroArticulos.Click
		If Type("thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos")<>"O"		 
			thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos","TG_FrmFiltroArticulos")				
		Endif	
		thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.Show()
		
		IF  thisform.Id_articuloDesde<>thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.Id_articuloDesde or ;
			thisform.Id_articuloHasta<>thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.Id_articuloHasta  or;	
			thisform.id_Marca<>thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.id_Marca  or;
			thisform.id_rubro<>thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.id_rubro  or;
			thisform.id_Subrubro<>thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.id_Subrubro  
		
		
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.t.
			ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	
		Endif	
		
		
		thisform.Id_articuloDesde=thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.Id_articuloDesde
		thisform.Id_articuloHasta=thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.Id_articuloHasta
		
		thisform.id_Marca=thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.id_Marca
		thisform.id_rubro=thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.id_rubro
		thisform.id_Subrubro=thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.id_Subrubro
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oOpgTipoComprobante.InteractiveChange
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldFormato
			ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	
		Endif	
		thisform.OldFormato=this.Value
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxFechaDesde.LostFocus
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldFechaDesde
			ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled		
		Endif
		thisform.OldFechaDesde=this.Value
			
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxFechaHasta.LostFocus
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldFechaHasta
			ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	
		Endif	
		thisform.OldFechaHasta=this.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.dblclickencelda
		thisform.MostrarComprobante
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_proveedores1.Valid
		local lValida
		lValida=tg_textclave::valid()
		thisform.CLienteValidado=.f.
		if lValida.and.!this.FormDesactivado 
				
				thisform.oTblProveedores.Buscar(this.Value)
				ThisForm.RazonSocial.Value=thisform.oTblProveedores.Leer("Razon_Social")
				
				thisform.oTblMonedas.Buscar(thisform.oTblProveedores.Leer("Id_Moneda_Cta"))
				thisform.oTbxMoneda.Value=thisform.oTblMonedas.Leer("Nombre")
				thisform.ClienteValidado=.t.
		endif
		If !this.FormDesactivado
			thisform.RefrescarConsulta
		Endif	
		
		If (thisform.ClienteValidado.or.lValida).and.!this.FormDesactivado
			ThisForm.Tg_seleccionarcomprobantesCompras1.Habilitar()
			thisform.oCmdDatosCliente.Enabled=.t.
			thisform.oCmdFiltroArticulos.Enabled=.t.
			
		Else
			ThisForm.Tg_seleccionarcomprobantesCompras1.DesHabilitar()
			thisform.oCmdDatosCliente.Enabled=.f.
			thisform.oCmdFiltroArticulos.Enabled=.f.
			
			
		Endif	
		
		
		Return thisform.ClienteValidado.or.lValida
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_seleccionarcomprobantescompras1.Init
		dodefault("Remunerativo=.t.",.t.)
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_seleccionarcomprobantescompras1.interactivechange
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled =this.ExistenMarcados()
		ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=.f.
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

	PROCEDURE calculartotalasignaciones
		Local mTotalAsignaciones, mRegistro, cId_Sucursal, cId_Comproba, nNro_Referencia, vGrabacion, lAsignaPago
		
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		mTotalAsignaciones = 0
		
		mRegistro = Thisform.oViewVencimientos.Recno()
		
		cId_Sucursal    = Thisform.oViewVencimientos.Leer("Id_Sucursal")
		cId_Comproba    = Thisform.oViewVencimientos.Leer("Id_Comproba")
		nNro_Referencia = Thisform.oViewVencimientos.Leer("Nro_Referencia")
		
		lAsignaPago = Thisform.oViewVencimientos.Leer("AsignaPago")
		
		Thisform.oViewVencimientos.IrPrimero()
		
		Do while !Thisform.oViewVencimientos.EsEof()
		
		   if Thisform.oViewVencimientos.Leer("Id_Sucursal") = cId_Sucursal and ;
		      Thisform.oViewVencimientos.Leer("Id_Comproba") = cId_Comproba and ;
		      Thisform.oViewVencimientos.Leer("Nro_Referencia") = nNro_Referencia
		      
		      =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"AsignaPago",lAsignaPago)
		      Thisform.oViewVencimientos.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)
		      
		   endif   
		
		   if Thisform.oViewVencimientos.Leer("AsignaPago")
		      mTotalAsignaciones = mTotalAsignaciones + thisform.oViewVencimientos.Leer("ImporteAsignaPago")
		   endif   
		   Thisform.oViewVencimientos.IrSiguiente()
		enddo
		
		Thisform.Tg_TextBox1.Value = mTotalAsignaciones
		
		Thisform.oViewVencimientos.IrRegistro(mRegistro)
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE grabarasignaciones
		Local vGrabacion, mClave, dFecha_Venc
		
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		Thisform.oViewVencimientos.IrPrimero()
		
		Do while !Thisform.oViewVencimientos.EsEof()
		   if Thisform.oViewVencimientos.Leer("Id_Comproba")<>space(3) and Thisform.oViewVencimientos.Leer("Saldo") > 0 
		   
		      mClave = Thisform.oViewVencimientos.Leer("Id_Sucursal")+"C"+Thisform.oViewVencimientos.Leer("Id_Comproba")+Str(Thisform.oViewVencimientos.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),10)
		      dFecha_Venc = Thisform.oViewVencimientos.Leer("Fecha_Venc")
		      
		      If Thisform.oTblCmp_Vencimientos.Buscar(mClave, .f., "Clave")
		         
		         do while !Thisform.oTblCmp_Vencimientos.EsEof() and Thisform.oTblCmp_Vencimientos.Leer("Id_Sucursal")+Thisform.oTblCmp_Vencimientos.Leer("Id_Sistema")+Thisform.oTblCmp_Vencimientos.Leer("Id_Comproba")+Str(Thisform.oTblCmp_Vencimientos.Leer("Nro_referencia"),10) = mclave
		            
		            if Thisform.oTblCmp_Vencimientos.Leer("Fecha_Venc") = dFecha_Venc
		               =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "AsignaPago"       , thisform.oViewVencimientos.Leer("AsignaPago"))				
		               =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "ImporteAsignaPago", Iif(thisform.oViewVencimientos.Leer("AsignaPago"),thisform.oViewVencimientos.Leer("ImporteAsignaPago"),0))				
		               =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Fecha_Pago"       , thisform.oViewVencimientos.Leer("Fecha_Pago"))				
			           thisform.oTblCmp_Vencimientos.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)
			           exit
			        endif      
			     
			        thisform.oTblCmp_Vencimientos.IrSiguiente()
			     
			     enddo
			     
			  endif   
			  
		   endif   
		   Thisform.oViewVencimientos.IrSiguiente()
		enddo
		
		Thisform.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.enabled = .t.
		Thisform.oViewVencimientos.IrPrimero()
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		lParameters cId_Proveedor
		
		dodefault()
		thisform.SetearHelpConTextId("ConsultaCompras")
		thisform.AddObject("oViewVencimientos","Tg_ViewVencimientosCompras")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblProveedores","tg_tabla","Proveedores","clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblMonedas","tg_tabla","Monedas","clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblParametros","tg_tabla","Parametros")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblCmp_Vencimientos","tg_tabla","Cmp_Vencimientos","Clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oCmp_Docu","tg_tabla","Cmp_docu","Clave")
		
		thisform.tg_PresentaMoneda1.AsignarMonedaDefault(thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("Mon_Def"))
		thisform.tg_cmbSucursales1.SetearTodos()
		thisform.tg_cmbSucursales1.Value="TD"
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewVencimientos.Alias
		thisform.oSpnDiasCorte.Value=1
		
		Thisform.oTbxFechaDesde.Value=cTod("  /  /  ")
		Thisform.oTbxFechaHasta.Value=cTod("  /  /  ")
		
		thisform.OldFechaDesde=Thisform.oTbxFechaDesde.Value
		thisform.OldFechaHasta=Thisform.oTbxFechaHasta.Value
		thisform.OldId_moneda=thisform.Tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarMoneda()
		thisform.OldId_Sucursal=thisform.Tg_CmbSucursales1.Value
		thisform.OldDiasCorte=thisform.oSpnDiasCorte.Value
		thisform.OldTipoCotizacion=thisform.Tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarTipoCotizacion()
		
		For mmpp=1 to thisform.tg_grid1.ColumnCount
			If mmpp<>9
				thisform.tg_Grid1.Columns(mmpp).DynamicBackColor="Iif(Empty(thisForm.oViewVencimientos.Leer('Id_comproba')),rgb(128,128,192),rgb(255,255,255))"
				thisform.tg_Grid1.Columns(mmpp).DynamicForeColor="Iif(Empty(thisForm.oViewVencimientos.Leer('Id_comproba')),rgb(128,128,192),rgb(0,0,0))"
			Else
				thisform.tg_Grid1.Columns(mmpp).DynamicBackColor="Iif(Empty(thisForm.oViewVencimientos.Leer('Id_comproba')),rgb(128,128,192),rgb(255,255,255))"
				thisform.tg_Grid1.Columns(mmpp).DynamicForeColor="Iif(Empty(thisForm.oViewVencimientos.Leer('Id_comproba')),rgb(255,255,255),rgb(0,0,0))"		
			Endif	
			
		EndFor
		
		Thisform.Tg_CommandButton1.Enabled = .f.
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarcomprobante
		Local cTexto,oLst
		If thisform.oViewVencimientos.Leer("Pago")
			If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaPago")<>T_OBJECT			 
				thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaPago","TG_ConsultaPago",thisform.oViewVencimientos.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oViewVencimientos.Leer("Id_Sistema"),thisform.oViewVencimientos.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewVencimientos.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),.t.)				
			Else
				Thisform.oFrmConsultaPago.ConsultarPago(thisform.oViewVencimientos.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oViewVencimientos.Leer("Id_Sistema"),thisform.oViewVencimientos.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewVencimientos.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),.t.)			
			Endif	
			thisform.oFrmConsultaPago.Show()
		
		Else
			If !Empty(thisform.oViewVencimientos.Leer("Id_Comproba"))
				If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante")<>T_OBJECT			 
					thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante","TG_ConsCompCompras",thisform.oViewVencimientos.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewVencimientos.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewVencimientos.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewVencimientos.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)				
				Else
					Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.ConsultarComprobante(thisform.oViewVencimientos.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewVencimientos.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewVencimientos.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewVencimientos.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)			
				Endif	
				thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.Show()		
			Endif	
		Endif	
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescaraplicacion
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarconsulta
		Local cId_sucursal
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewVencimientos.Alias
		thisform.SetearCursorEspera
		If ThisForm.Tg_cmbsucursales1.Value="TD"
			cId_Sucursal=""
		Else
			cId_Sucursal=ThisForm.Tg_cmbsucursales1.Value
		Endif
		
		
		
		thisform.LockScreen=.t.	
		
		*thisform.oViewVencimientos.Refrescar("",cId_Sucursal,ThisForm.oTbxFechaDesde.Value,ThisForm.oTbxFechaHasta.Value,ThisForm.Tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarMoneda(),thisform.oSpnDiasCorte.Value,ThisForm.Tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarTipoCotizacion())
		
		thisform.oViewVencimientos.Refrescar(Thisform.Tg_Proveedores1.value,cId_Sucursal,ThisForm.oTbxFechaDesde.Value,ThisForm.oTbxFechaHasta.Value,ThisForm.Tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarMoneda(),thisform.oSpnDiasCorte.Value,ThisForm.Tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarTipoCotizacion())
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewVencimientos.Alias
				
		thisform.RefrescarGrilla
		thisform.LockScreen=.F.	
		thisform.DesSetearCursorEspera
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla
		local vGrabacion
		
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		** Parametro intocable porque a veces no puedo hacer el setfocus cuando se hace
		** un refrescarAplicacion desde otro objeto, este no puede tomar el foco sino
		** se lo debe dejar al otro objeto sin quitarselo
		
		Thisform.Tg_CommandButton1.Enabled = .t.
		
		Thisform.oViewVencimientos.IrPrimero()
		
		Do while !Thisform.oViewVencimientos.EsEof()
		   if !Thisform.oViewVencimientos.Leer("AsignaPago") and Thisform.oViewVencimientos.Leer("Id_Comproba")<>space(3) and Thisform.oViewVencimientos.Leer("Saldo")>0
		      Thisform.oCmp_Docu.Buscar(Thisform.oViewVencimientos.Leer("Id_Comproba"),.f.,"Clave")
		
		      
		      if Thisform.oCmp_docu.Leer("Pago")
		   	     =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "ImporteAsignaPago", 0)				
		   	     =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "AsignaPago", .f.)				
		      else
			     =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "ImporteAsignaPago", thisform.oViewVencimientos.Leer("Saldo"))				
			  endif
			  
			  thisform.oViewVencimientos.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)
		   endif   
		   
		   if Thisform.oViewVencimientos.Leer("Fecha_Pago") = ctod("  /  /  ")
		      =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Fecha_Pago", thisform.oViewVencimientos.Leer("fecha_venc"))				
		      thisform.oViewVencimientos.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)
		   endif
		   
		   Thisform.oViewVencimientos.IrSiguiente()
		enddo
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		**thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSourceType=1
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewVencimientos.Alias
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource=thisform.oViewVencimientos.Alias+".Id_sucursal"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource=thisform.oViewVencimientos.Alias+".Id_Comproba"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource=thisform.oViewVencimientos.Alias+".Nro_Referencia"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column4.ControlSource=thisform.oViewVencimientos.Alias+".Nro_externo"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column5.ControlSource=thisform.oViewVencimientos.Alias+".Fecha"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column6.ControlSource=thisform.oViewVencimientos.Alias+".Fecha_Venc"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column7.ControlSource=thisform.oViewVencimientos.Alias+".ImporteCuota"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column8.ControlSource=thisform.oViewVencimientos.Alias+".ImportePago"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column9.ControlSource=thisform.oViewVencimientos.Alias+".Saldo"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column10.ControlSource=thisform.oViewVencimientos.Alias+".Id_Proveedor"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column11.ControlSource=thisform.oViewVencimientos.Alias+".Nombre"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column12.ControlSource=thisform.oViewVencimientos.Alias+".ImporteAsignaPago"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column13.ControlSource=thisform.oViewVencimientos.Alias+".asignaPago"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column14.ControlSource=thisform.oViewVencimientos.Alias+".Fecha_Pago"
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Refresh
		
		Thisform.oViewVencimientos.IrPrimero()
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE grabarasignaciones
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		lparameters cId_Sucursal,cId_sistema,cId_comproba,nNro_referencia,dFecha,nTotaldeuda,cId_Proveedor,cNombreProveedor
		local vGrabacion,cNombrecomprobante,cMascaraDatos,nAlternativa,cInsumoDirecto,lExplotacionDirecta
		
		dodefault()
		
		Dimension vGrabacion [1,2]
		
		thisform.AddObject("oTblCalculoRequerimientos","tg_tabla","Aux_RequerimientosProduccion","clave")
		thisform.oTblCalculoRequerimientos.SetearProp ("BOT")
		
		thisform.AddObject("oTblCmp_docu","tg_tabla","Cmp_Docu","clave")
		thisform.oTblCmp_docu.Buscar(cId_comproba,.f.,"Clave")
		cNombrecomprobante = thisform.oTblCmp_docu.Leer("nombre")
		cMascaraDatos = replicate("9",thisform.oTblCmp_docu.Leer("enteros_cantidad"))+"."+replicate("9",thisform.oTblCmp_docu.Leer("decimales_cantidad"))
		
		thisform.tg_label1.caption = thisform.tg_label1.caption + "    " + cNombrecomprobante
		thisform.tg_label2.caption = thisform.tg_label2.caption + "    " + str(nNro_referencia,10)
		thisform.tg_label3.caption = thisform.tg_label3.caption + "    " + DTOC(dFecha)
		thisform.tg_label5.caption = thisform.tg_label5.caption + "    " + cNombreProveedor
		thisform.tg_label6.caption = thisform.tg_label6.caption + "    " + str(ntotaldeuda,12,2)
		
		* apertura de archivos necesarios
		thisform.AddObject("oTblArticulos","tg_tabla","Articulos","clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblStk_Kits","tg_tabla","Stk_Kits","clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblStk_KitsAlternativas","tg_tabla","Stk_KitsAlternativas","clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblStk_KitsTalleColor","tg_tabla","Stk_KitsTalleColor","clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblCmp_Detalle","tg_tabla","Cmp_Detalle","clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblMovArtTalleColor","tg_tabla","MovArtTalleColor","clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblStk_Stock","tg_tabla","Stk_Stock","clave")
		
		
		thisform.oTblCmp_Detalle.IrPrimero()
		
		thisform.oTblCmp_Detalle.Buscar(cId_sucursal+cId_Sistema+cId_comproba+Str(nNro_referencia,10),.f.,"Clave")
		
		do while !thisform.oTblCmp_Detalle.EsEof() and Thisform.oTblCmp_Detalle.Leer("Id_Sucursal") = cId_Sucursal ;
		                                           and Thisform.oTblCmp_Detalle.Leer("Id_Sistema") = cId_Sistema ;
		                                           and Thisform.oTblCmp_Detalle.Leer("Id_Comproba") = cId_Comproba ;
		                                           and Thisform.oTblCmp_Detalle.Leer("nro_referencia") = nNro_referencia
		                                           
		      cId_Articulo = Thisform.oTblCmp_Detalle.Leer("Id_Articulo")                                     
		      nCantidad = Thisform.oTblCmp_Detalle.Leer("Cantidad")                                           
		      nAlternativa = Thisform.oTblCmp_Detalle.Leer("Alternativa")                                           
		             
		      thisform.oTblStk_KitsAlternativas.Buscar(cId_Articulo+str(nAlternativa,2),.f.,"Clave")
		      
		      do while !thisform.oTblStk_KitsAlternativas.EsEof() and thisform.oTblStk_KitsAlternativas.Leer("Id_ArticuloKit") = cId_Articulo ;
		                                                          and thisform.oTblStk_KitsAlternativas.Leer("Alternativa") = nAlternativa
		         
		         cId_ArticuloRequerido = thisform.oTblStk_KitsAlternativas.Leer("Id_Articulo")
		         nCantRequerida = thisform.oTblStk_KitsAlternativas.Leer("Cantidad") * nCantidad
		         cInsumoDirecto = iif(thisform.oTblStk_KitsAlternativas.Leer("InsumoDirecto"),"S","N")
		         
		         lExplotacionDirecta = thisform.oTblStk_KitsAlternativas.Leer("ExplotacionDirecta")
		         
		         if lExplotacionDirecta  && implica meterme en la formula de stk_kits
		         
		            if Thisform.oTblStk_Kits.Buscar(cId_ArticuloRequerido,.f.,"Clave")
		            
		               Do while !thisform.oTblStk_Kits.EsEof() and thisform.oTblStk_Kits.Leer("Id_ArticuloKit") = cId_ArticuloRequerido
		               
		                  cId_ArticuloExplotacion = thisform.oTblStk_Kits.Leer("Id_Articulo")
		                  thisform.oTblArticulos.Buscar(cId_ArticuloExplotacion,.f.,"Clave")
		                  cNombre = thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Nombre")
		                  nMinimo = thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Reposicion")
		                  nAsignado = thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Asignado")
		                  nPendientes = thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Pendientes")
		                  nCantRequerida = nCantidad * thisform.oTblStk_Kits.Leer("Cantidad")
		                  cInsumoDirecto = iif(thisform.oTblStk_Kits.Leer("InsumoDirecto"),"S","N")
		
		                  thisform.oTblCalculoRequerimientos.Buscar(cId_ArticuloExplotacion+cInsumoDirecto,.f.,"Clave")
		
		                  if thisform.oTblCalculoRequerimientos.EsEof()
		         
		                     =FGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Id_Articulo"        , cId_ArticuloExplotacion )    
		                     =FGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Nombre"             , cNombre )    
		                     =FGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Requerimiento"      , nCantRequerida )    
		                     =FGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Minimo"             , nMinimo )    
		                     =FGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Asignado"           , nAsignado )    
		                     =FGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Pendientes"         , nPendientes )    
		                     =FGrabar(@vGrabacion, "InsumoDirecto"      , iif(cInsumoDirecto="S",.t.,.f.))    
		                     =FGrabar(@vGrabacion, "ID"                 , cInsumoDirecto)
		                                    
		                     thisform.oTblCalculoRequerimientos.AgregaryModificar(@vGrabacion, .t.)
		            
		                  else
		         
		                     =FGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Requerimiento"      , Thisform.oTblCalculoRequerimientos.Leer("Requerimiento") + nCantRequerida )    
		                     thisform.oTblCalculoRequerimientos.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)
		            
		                  endif
		               
		                  thisform.oTblStk_Kits.IrSiguiente()
		               enddo
		             
		            endif
		         
		         else
		         
		            thisform.oTblCalculoRequerimientos.Buscar(cId_ArticuloRequerido+cInsumoDirecto,.f.,"Clave")
		
		            if thisform.oTblCalculoRequerimientos.EsEof()
		         
		               thisform.oTblArticulos.Buscar(cId_ArticuloRequerido,.f.,"Clave")
		               cNombre = thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Nombre")
		               nMinimo = thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Reposicion")
		               nAsignado = thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Asignado")
		               nPendientes = thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Pendientes")
		            
		               =FGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Id_Articulo"        , cId_ArticuloRequerido )    
		               =FGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Nombre"             , cNombre )    
		               =FGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Requerimiento"      , nCantRequerida )    
		               =FGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Minimo"             , nMinimo )    
		               =FGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Asignado"           , nAsignado )    
		               =FGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Pendientes"         , nPendientes )    
		               =FGrabar(@vGrabacion, "InsumoDirecto"      , iif(cInsumoDirecto="S",.t.,.f.))    
		               =FGrabar(@vGrabacion, "ID"                 , cInsumoDirecto)
		                                    
		               thisform.oTblCalculoRequerimientos.AgregaryModificar(@vGrabacion, .t.)
		            
		            else
		         
		               =FGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Requerimiento"      , Thisform.oTblCalculoRequerimientos.Leer("Requerimiento") + nCantRequerida )    
		               thisform.oTblCalculoRequerimientos.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)
		            
		            endif
		            
		         endif
		         
		         thisform.oTblStk_KitsAlternativas.IrSiguiente()
		         
		      enddo                             
		      
		      thisform.oTblCmp_Detalle.IrSiguiente()
		              
		enddo
		 
		thisform.oTblMovArtTalleColor.IrPrimero()
		
		thisform.oTblMovArtTalleColor.Buscar(cId_sucursal+cId_Sistema+cId_comproba+Str(nNro_referencia,10),.f.,"Clave")
		
		do while !thisform.oTblMovArtTalleColor.EsEof() and Thisform.oTblMovArtTalleColor.Leer("Id_Sucursal") = cId_Sucursal ;
		                                                and Thisform.oTblMovArtTalleColor.Leer("Id_Sistema") = cId_Sistema ;
		                                                and Thisform.oTblMovArtTalleColor.Leer("Id_Comproba") = cId_Comproba ;
		                                                and Thisform.oTblMovArtTalleColor.Leer("nro_referencia") = nNro_referencia
		                                           
		      cId_Articulo = Thisform.oTblMovArtTalleColor.Leer("Id_Articulo")                                     
		      cId_Talle = Thisform.oTblMovArtTalleColor.Leer("Id_Talle")                                     
		      cId_Color = Thisform.oTblMovArtTalleColor.Leer("Id_Color")                                     
		      nCantidad = Thisform.oTblMovArtTalleColor.Leer("Cantidad")                                           
		             
		      thisform.oTblStk_KitsTalleColor.Buscar(cId_Articulo+cId_Talle+cId_Color,.f.,"Clave")
		      
		      do while !thisform.oTblStk_KitsTalleColor.EsEof() and thisform.oTblStk_KitsTalleColor.Leer("Id_ArticuloKit") = cId_Articulo ;
		                                                        and thisform.oTblStk_KitsTalleColor.Leer("Id_Talle") = cId_Talle ;
		                                                        and thisform.oTblStk_KitsTalleColor.Leer("Id_Color") = cId_Color
		                                                               
		         cId_ArticuloRequerido = thisform.oTblStk_KitsTallecolor.Leer("Id_Articulo")
		         nCantRequerida = thisform.oTblStk_KitsTalleColor.Leer("Cantidad") * nCantidad
		         
		         thisform.oTblCalculoRequerimientos.Buscar(cId_ArticuloRequerido+"N",.f.,"Clave")
		
		         if thisform.oTblCalculoRequerimientos.EsEof()
		         
		            thisform.oTblArticulos.Buscar(cId_ArticuloRequerido,.f.,"Clave")
		            cNombre = thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Nombre")
		            nMinimo = thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Reposicion")
		            nAsignado = thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Asignado")
		            nPendientes = thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Pendientes")
		            
		            =FGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Id_Articulo"        , cId_ArticuloRequerido )    
		            =FGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Nombre"             , cNombre )    
		            =FGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Requerimiento"      , nCantRequerida )    
		            =FGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Minimo"             , nMinimo )    
		            =FGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Asignado"           , nAsignado )    
		            =FGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Pendientes"         , nPendientes )    
		            =FGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Id"                 , "N" )    
		            
		            thisform.oTblCalculoRequerimientos.AgregaryModificar(@vGrabacion, .t.)
		            
		         else
		         
		            =FGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Requerimiento"      , Thisform.oTblCalculoRequerimientos.Leer("Requerimiento") + nCantRequerida )    
		            thisform.oTblCalculoRequerimientos.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)
		            
		         endif
		         
		         thisform.oTblStk_KitsTalleColor.IrSiguiente()
		         
		      enddo                             
		      
		      thisform.oTblMovArtTalleColor.IrSiguiente()
		              
		enddo
		
		cId_Sucursal = oApp.CodSucursal() 
		                                              
		thisform.oTblCalculoRequerimientos.IrPrimero()
		
		do while !thisform.oTblCalculoRequerimientos.EsEof()
		
		   cId_articulo = thisform.oTblCalculoRequerimientos.Leer("Id_Articulo")
		   nMinimo = thisform.oTblCalculoRequerimientos.Leer("MInimo")
		   nAsignado = thisform.oTblCalculoRequerimientos.Leer("Asignado")
		   nPendientes = thisform.oTblCalculoRequerimientos.Leer("Pendientes")
		   nRequerimiento = thisform.oTblCalculoRequerimientos.Leer("Requerimiento")
		   
		   thisform.oTblStk_Stock.IrPrimero()
		   
		   thisform.oTblStk_Stock.Buscar(cId_Sucursal+cId_Articulo+space(3),.t.,"Clave")   
		   
		   nStock = 0
		   do while !Thisform.oTblStk_Stock.EsEof() and Thisform.oTblStk_Stock.Leer("Id_Articulo") = cId_Articulo
		   
		      nStock = nStock + Thisform.oTblStk_Stock.Leer("Saldo")
		      
		      Thisform.oTblStk_Stock.IrSiguiente()
		      
		   enddo
		
		   nCompras = nRequerimiento + nMinimo + nAsignado - nPendientes - nStock
		   
		   =FGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Stock"      , nStock )    
		   =FGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Compras"    , nCompras )    
		   
		   thisform.oTblCalculoRequerimientos.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)
		      
		   thisform.oTblCalculoRequerimientos.IrSiguiente()
		   
		enddo
		
		thisform.oTblCalculoRequerimientos.IrPrimero()
		
		*thisform.tg_grid1.ResaltarRenglon
		
		Thisform.tg_grid1.ReadOnly= .f.
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		*thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewComADescargarDetallepiqueo.Alias
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oTblCalculoRequerimientos.Alias
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.text1.inputmask = cMascaraDatos
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column4.text1.inputmask = cMascaraDatos
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column5.text1.inputmask = cMascaraDatos
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column6.text1.inputmask = cMascaraDatos
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column7.text1.inputmask = cMascaraDatos
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column8.text1.inputmask = cMascaraDatos
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column1.enabled = .f.
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column2.enabled = .f.
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.enabled = .f.
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column4.enabled = .f.
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column5.enabled = .f.
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column6.enabled = .f.
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column7.enabled = .f.
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column8.enabled = .f.
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column9.enabled = .f.
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource=thisform.oTblCalculoRequerimientos.Alias+".Id_articulo"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource=thisform.oTblCalculoRequerimientos.Alias+".nombre"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource=thisform.oTblCalculoRequerimientos.Alias+".stock"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column4.ControlSource=thisform.oTblCalculoRequerimientos.Alias+".requerimiento"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column5.ControlSource=thisform.oTblCalculoRequerimientos.Alias+".pendientes"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column6.ControlSource=thisform.oTblCalculoRequerimientos.Alias+".minimo"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column7.ControlSource=thisform.oTblCalculoRequerimientos.Alias+".asignado"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column8.ControlSource=thisform.oTblCalculoRequerimientos.Alias+".compras"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column9.ControlSource=thisform.oTblCalculoRequerimientos.Alias+".InsumoDirecto"
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Refresh
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarasignacionarticulo
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.Column5.Text1.DblClick
		thisform.mostrarasignacionarticulo
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.Column5.Text1.Valid
		
		if thisform.tg_grid1.Column5.text1.value <= thisform.oTblPiqueoauxiliar.Leer("Cantidad") and thisform.tg_grid1.Column5.text1.value <= thisform.oTblPiqueoauxiliar.Leer("Stock")
		   if thisform.tg_grid1.Column5.text1.value <> thisform.oTblPiqueoauxiliar.Leer("CantFijaAnt")
		      thisform.tg_grid1.Column6.tg_CheckBox1.value = .t.
		   *else   
		   *   thisform.tg_grid1.Column6.tg_CheckBox1.value = .f.
		   endif   
		   return (.t.)
		else
		   return (.f.)
		endif      
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

DEFINE CLASS tg_comadescargarcompras AS tg_form OF "tg_clasesbasicas.vcx" 
 	*< CLASSDATA: Baseclass="form" Timestamp="" Scale="Pixels" Uniqueid="" />

	*-- OBJECTDATA items order determines ZOrder / El orden de los items OBJECTDATA determina el ZOrder 
	*< OBJECTDATA: ObjPath="Tg_3dshape1" UniqueID="" Timestamp="" />
	*< OBJECTDATA: ObjPath="Tg_seleccionarcomprobantescompras1" UniqueID="" Timestamp="" />
	*< OBJECTDATA: ObjPath="Tg_3dshape2" UniqueID="" Timestamp="" />
	*< OBJECTDATA: ObjPath="Tg_grid1" UniqueID="" Timestamp="" />

	PROCEDURE Init
		
		dodefault()
		thisform.SetearHelpConTextId("ConsultaCompras")
		thisform.AddObject("oViewComADescargar","Tg_ViewComADescargarCompras")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblProveedores","tg_tabla","Proveedores","clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblMonedas","tg_tabla","Monedas","clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblParametros","tg_tabla","Parametros")
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewComADescargar.Alias
		thisform.AddObject("Tg_MenuLib1","tg_MenuLib")
		
		*!*	ThisForm.Tg_seleccionarcomprobantescompras1.DesHabilitar()
		
		
		
		thisform.tg_PresentaMoneda1.AsignarMonedaDefault(thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("Mon_Def"))
		thisform.tg_cmbSucursales1.SetearTodos()
		thisform.tg_cmbSucursales1.Value="TD"
		
		Thisform.oTbxFechaDesde.Value=cTod("  /  /  ")
		Thisform.oTbxFechaHasta.Value=cTod("  /  /  ")
		
		thisform.OldFechaDesde=Thisform.oTbxFechaDesde.Value
		thisform.OldFechaHasta=Thisform.oTbxFechaHasta.Value
		thisform.OldId_moneda=thisform.Tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarMoneda()
		thisform.OldTipoCotizacion=thisform.Tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarTipoCotizacion()
		
		thisform.OldId_Sucursal=thisform.Tg_CmbSucursales1.Value
		
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.ResaltarRenglon
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarcomprobante
		Local cTexto,oLst
		
		If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante")<>T_OBJECT			 
			thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante","TG_ConsCompCompras",thisform.oViewComADescargar.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComADescargar.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewComADescargar.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewComADescargar.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)				
		Else
			Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.ConsultarComprobante(thisform.oViewComADescargar.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComADescargar.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewComADescargar.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewComADescargar.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)			
		Endif	
		
		thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.Show()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarmenu
		Local vVector[2]
		
		vVector[1]="Consultar Comprobante..."
		vVector[2]="Consultar Pendiente...  "
		
		ThisForm.Tg_menulib1.ShowMenu(@vVector)
		
		Do case 
			Case Bar()=1
					thisform.MostrarComprobante
			Case Bar()=2
					thisform.MostrarPendiente
		
		EndCase	
		
		Return 
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarpendiente
		if type("thisform.oFrmArtPendComprobante")<>T_OBJECT
			thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmArtPendComprobante","TG_ConsultarArtPendComprobanteCompra")
		
		Endif
		thisform.oFrmArtPendComprobante.SetearConsulta(thisform.oViewComADescargar.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oViewComADescargar.Leer("Id_Sistema"),thisform.oViewComADescargar.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComADescargar.Leer("Nro_Referencia"))
		thisform.oFrmArtPendComprobante.Show()
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescaraplicacion
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarconsulta
		Local cId_sucursal
		
		Thisform.SetearCursorEspera
		
		If ThisForm.Tg_cmbsucursales1.Value="TD"
			cId_Sucursal=""
		Else
			cId_Sucursal=ThisForm.Tg_cmbsucursales1.Value
		Endif
		
		
		
		=aCopy(ThisForm.Tg_seleccionarcomprobantescompras1.vItems,vComprobantes)
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		thisform.oViewComADescargar.Refrescar(@vComprobantes,"",cId_Sucursal,ThisForm.oTbxFechaDesde.Value,ThisForm.oTbxFechaHasta.Value,ThisForm.Tg_Presentamoneda1.ConsultarMoneda(),ThisForm.Tg_Presentamoneda1.ConsultarTipoCotizacion())
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewComADescargar.Alias
		
		thisform.RefrescarGrilla
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.f.
		ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
		thisform.LockScreen=.f.	
		Thisform.DesSetearCursorEspera
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla
		
		
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewComADescargar.Alias
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComADescargar.Alias+".Id_sucursal"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComADescargar.Alias+".Id_Comproba"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComADescargar.Alias+".Nro_Referencia"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column4.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComADescargar.Alias+".Nro_externo"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column5.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComADescargar.Alias+".Fecha"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column6.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComADescargar.Alias+".TotalDeuda"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column7.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComADescargar.Alias+".Pendiente"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column8.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComADescargar.Alias+".Id_Proveedor"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column9.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComADescargar.Alias+".Nombre"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column10.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComADescargar.Alias+".vencimiento"
		
		
		
		*!*	thisform.oCmdDetalle.Enabled=!thisform.oViewComADescargar.EsTablaVacia()
		
		
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Refresh
		
		
		thisform.oTbxTotalPendiente.Value=Round(thisform.oViewComADescargar.Sumar("Pendiente",".t."),2)
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Click
		this.Enabled=.f.
		thisform.tg_CommandButton1.Enabled=.t.
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxFechaDesde.LostFocus
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldFechaDesde
			ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	
		Endif
		thisform.OldFechaDesde=this.Value
			
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxFechaHasta.LostFocus
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldFechaHasta
			ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	
		Endif	
		thisform.OldFechaHasta=this.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_cmbsucursales1.InteractiveChange
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldId_Sucursal
			ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	
		Endif	
		thisform.OldId_Sucursal=this.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_commandbutton1.Click
		Local oAbmGen
		
		
		If !thisform.oViewComADescargar.EsEof()
			oAbmGen=CreateObject("tg_FormConsulta","Proveedores",.f.,thisform.oViewComADescargar.Leer("Id_Proveedor"))
			oAbmGen.Show()
		Endif
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.Column1.Text1.GotFocus
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.dblclickencelda
		thisform.MostrarComprobante
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.rightclickencelda
		thisform.MostrarMenu
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_presentamoneda1.interactivechange
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			If this.ConsultarMoneda()<>thisform.OldId_Moneda .or. this.ConsultarTipoCotizacion()<>thisform.OldTipoCotizacion
				ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.t.
			Endif	
		Endif	
		thisform.OldId_Moneda=this.ConsultarMoneda()
		thisform.OldTipoCotizacion=this.ConsultarTipoCotizacion()
		ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_seleccionarcomprobantescompras1.Init
		dodefault("List_Com_Pen=.t.",.t.)
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_seleccionarcomprobantescompras1.interactivechange
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled =this.ExistenMarcados()
		ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=.f.
		
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

	PROCEDURE Init
		lParameters cId_Proveedor
		
		dodefault()
		thisform.SetearHelpConTextId("ConsultaCompras")
		thisform.AddObject("oViewComADescargarProveedor","Tg_ViewComADescargarProveedor")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblProveedores","tg_tabla","Proveedores","clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblMonedas","tg_tabla","Monedas","clave")
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewComADescargarProveedor.Alias
		thisform.tg_Proveedores1.Valida=TG_TC_VALIDAEXISTENCIA 
		ThisForm.Tg_seleccionarcomprobantesCompras1.DesHabilitar()
		
		thisform.AddObject("Tg_MenuLib1","tg_MenuLib")
		
		
		If Type("cId_Proveedor")<>T_LOGICAL
			thisform.tg_Proveedores1.Value=cId_Proveedor
		*!*		thisform.tg_grid1.SetFocus()
			thisform.tg_Proveedores1.Valid
			thisform.tg_Proveedores1.Enabled=.f.
		Endif
		
		thisform.Tg_grid1.ResaltarRenglon
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarcomprobante
		Local cTexto,oLst
		
		If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante")<>T_OBJECT	
			thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante","TG_ConsCompCompras",thisform.oViewComADescargarProveedor.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComADescargarProveedor.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewComADescargarProveedor.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewComADescargarProveedor.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)				
		Else
			Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.ConsultarComprobante(thisform.oViewComADescargarProveedor.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComADescargarProveedor.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewComADescargarProveedor.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewComADescargarProveedor.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)			
		Endif	
		
		thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.Show()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarmenu
		Local vVector[2]
		
		vVector[1]="Consultar Comprobante..."
		vVector[2]="Consultar Pendiente...  "
		
		ThisForm.Tg_menulib1.ShowMenu(@vVector)
		
		Do case 
			Case Bar()=1
					thisform.MostrarComprobante
			Case Bar()=2
					thisform.MostrarPendiente
		
		EndCase	
		
		Return 
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarpendiente
		if type("thisform.oFrmArtPendComprobante")<>T_OBJECT
			thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmArtPendComprobante","TG_ConsultarArtPendComprobanteCompra")
		
		Endif
		thisform.oFrmArtPendComprobante.SetearConsulta(thisform.oViewComADescargarProveedor.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oViewComADescargarProveedor.Leer("Id_Sistema"),thisform.oViewComADescargarProveedor.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComADescargarProveedor.Leer("Nro_Referencia"))
		thisform.oFrmArtPendComprobante.Show()
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescaraplicacion
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarconsulta
		thisform.LockScreen=.t.	
		thisform.SetearCursorEspera
		=aCopy(ThisForm.Tg_seleccionarcomprobantesCompras1.vItems,vComprobantes)
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		thisform.oViewComADescargarProveedor.Refrescar(thisForm.tg_Proveedores1.Value,@vComprobantes)
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewComADescargarProveedor.Alias
		
		thisform.RefrescarGrilla
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.f.
		ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
		
		thisform.LockScreen=.f.	
		thisform.DesSetearCursorEspera
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla
		
		
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewComADescargarProveedor.Alias
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComADescargarProveedor.Alias+".Id_sucursal"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComADescargarProveedor.Alias+".Id_Comproba"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComADescargarProveedor.Alias+".Nro_Referencia"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column4.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComADescargarProveedor.Alias+".Nro_externo"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column5.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComADescargarProveedor.Alias+".Fecha"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column6.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComADescargarProveedor.Alias+".TotalDeuda"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column7.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComADescargarProveedor.Alias+".Pendiente"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column8.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComADescargarProveedor.Alias+".Vencimiento"
		
		
		
		
		*!*	thisform.oCmdDetalle.Enabled=!thisform.oViewComADescargarProveedor.EsTablaVacia()
		
		
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Refresh
		
		
		thisform.oTbxTotalPendiente.Value=Round(thisform.oViewComADescargarProveedor.Sumar("Pendiente",".t."),2)
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdDatosProveedor.Click
		Local oAbmGen
		
		oAbmGen=CreateObject("tg_FormConsulta","Proveedores",.f.,thisform.tg_Proveedores1.Value)
		oAbmGen.Show()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Click
		this.Parent.RefrescarConsulta
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.Column1.Text1.GotFocus
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.dblclickencelda
		thisform.MostrarComprobante
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.rightclickencelda
		thisform.MostrarMenu
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_proveedores1.Valid
		local lValida
		lValida=tg_textclave::valid()
		thisform.ProveedorValidado=.f.
		if lValida.and.!this.FormDesactivado &&.and.!thisform.ProveedorValidado
				
				thisform.oTblProveedores.Buscar(this.Value)
				ThisForm.RazonSocial.Value=thisform.oTblProveedores.Leer("Razon_Social")
				
				thisform.oTblMonedas.Buscar(thisform.oTblProveedores.Leer("Id_Moneda_Cta"))
				thisform.oTbxMoneda.Value=thisform.oTblMonedas.Leer("Nombre")
				thisform.ProveedorValidado=.t.
		endif
		If !this.FormDesactivado
			thisform.RefrescarConsulta
		Endif	
		
		If (thisform.ProveedorValidado.or.lValida).and.!this.FormDesactivado
			ThisForm.Tg_seleccionarcomprobantesCompras1.Habilitar()
			thisform.oCmdDatosProveedor.Enabled=.t.
		Else
			ThisForm.Tg_seleccionarcomprobantesCompras1.DesHabilitar()
			thisform.oCmdDatosProveedor.Enabled=.f.
		Endif	
		
		
		
		Return thisform.ProveedorValidado.or.lValida
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_seleccionarcomprobantescompras1.Init
		dodefault("List_Com_Pen=.t.",.t.)
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_seleccionarcomprobantescompras1.interactivechange
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled =this.ExistenMarcados()
		ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=.f.
		
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE
